```text
1	# Command navigation
2	
3	`dev --help` presents 17 primary entrypoints. `dev help --tree` shows two levels
4	of the canonical tree; `--depth 0` expands all levels, an optional command path
5	focuses a subtree, and `--aliases` includes shortcuts. Use leaf `--help` for
6	syntax and `dev help <topic>` for workflow guidance.
7	
8	| Family | Operations |
9	|---|---|
10	| `work` | list/start/park/resume/done/adopt/retire/sweep |
11	| `repo` | repository operations, bootstrap, note, independent flow preview |
12	| `tries` | try/open/list/graduate/demote and retention |
13	| `git` | transactions, ignore, worktree, submodule, hygiene |
14	| `agent` | skill, mcp, instructions, prompt, artifact including prepare |
15	| `activity` | journal, durable stats |
16	| `self` | config/cache/doctor/version/upgrade/completion/shell-init/feedback |
17	
18	The independent roots are snippet, ssh, fleet, dotfile, pr, summary, triage,
19	status, tui and help. Older top-level spellings remain permanent shortcuts with
20	unchanged arguments, output and exit behavior. They do not emit deprecation
21	warnings. Existing JSON and task/catalog storage contracts are unchanged.
22	
23	`dev try <name>` and `dev tries try <name>` retain create-or-open semantics,
24	including names matching management verbs. `dev gist` retains GitHub-only scope.
25	`dev prepare` is `dev agent artifact prepare`; `dev edit` is `dev self config edit`.
26	`dev git ignore --stdout/--list` remains usable outside repositories.
27	
28	`dev repo cd <repo>` is equivalent to `dev repo open <repo> --runtime none`.
29	It preserves repository completion and resolution, always bypassing runtime
30	launch/focus. The shell wrapper consumes its directory handoff; without the
31	wrapper it prints a quoted `cd` command.
32	
33	Prefer canonical paths in new guidance. Root completion emphasizes these paths;
34	shortcut argument/flag completion stays available. Reload shell integration
35	after an upgrade with `dev self shell-init <shell>`.
36	
37	## Try graduation and demotion
38	
39	### Graduation (v0.3.1)
40	
41	`dev tries graduate [try]` and `dev graduate` share the terminal/dashboard
42	wizard: name, optional category, local (default)/add URL/create GitHub or GitLab,
43	then preview and confirm. The reviewed source identity and contents are
44	revalidated before apply. `--yes`/`-y` or non-TTY use runs directly from flags;
45	`--dry-run` never prompts, probes forge authentication, moves or publishes.
46	
47	Use `--remote-url` for an existing URL, or `--forge github|gitlab` for creation;
48	`--remote` retains automatic create-provider selection. Forge also accepts
49	`auto|none`. Creation supports `--namespace` and `--visibility private|public|internal`
50	(internal only on GitLab); legacy `--private` remains compatible. Create defaults
51	to private with push, add URL to no push; explicit `--push[=false]` overrides.
52	Any existing remote blocks add/create and is preserved by local graduation.
53	A local name does not rename source code or an existing remote repository.
54	
55	Regraduation name precedence is explicit `--name`, optional `graduated_name`,
56	valid legacy `graduated_path` basename (POSIX or Windows), then date-stripped Try
57	name. Fallback is read-only. Only successful local graduation records the name,
58	time and path together; category is not remembered. A later remote failure
59	keeps these local facts, returns nonzero, and never automatically retries or
60	rolls back the local project or completed remote effects. Inspect the reported
61	outcome before a follow-up publication action.
62	Publication revalidates the graduated checkout and reviewed branch/commit before
63	each stage. Drift after remote creation retains the remote and skips push.
64	Provider/authentication preflight errors stop before the local move.
65	
66	### Demotion
67	
68	`dev tries demote <repo-or-path-or-catalog-id> [--to <path>] [--dry-run]`
69	accepts only previously graduated Tries. It returns the current bytes and stable
70	identity to the configured Try root as active/present, retaining dirty/untracked/
71	ignored files, Git history/remotes, tags, notes and prior graduation history.
72	It does not reverse Git initialization, commits or publication, create a symlink,
73	retarget task/runtime/artifact ownership, or turn an arbitrary repo into a Try.
74	
75	Run from outside the source checkout. Observations cover all available runtime
76	backends; incomplete coverage or `none` cannot prove absence. The destination
77	must be an immediate visible child of the current Try root. The recorded original
78	Try path is the default destination. An occupied or
79	out-of-root original path requires an explicit safe `--to`; never overwrite or
80	invent a new destination. Plan/apply revalidates source, destination, catalog,
81	Git and live ownership. Incomplete observations, active claims, canonical repositories with linked
82	worktrees and unsafe/cross-filesystem paths block the move; preserve its recovery
83	journal on an interrupted operation. Use `--dry-run` to preview or REPOS's
84	confirmed demote action.
85	
86	On Windows, demotion and concurrent dev lifecycle writers must all use v0.3.0
87	or later to share the lease across the directory move. Older dev binaries, raw
88	Git and external tools are outside this move guarantee.
89	
90	Keep identity, intent and storage separate: graduate/demote changes Try/Repo
91	identity; deprecate/reactivate changes intent without moving files; archive/
92	restore moves retained bytes. Delete normally uses system Trash; restore there
93	before `tries restore --from`. Permanent deletion is not recoverable.
94
```

```text
255		return e.ID
256	}
257	
258	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
259	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
260		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
261		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
262	}
263	
264	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
265	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
266		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
267		return location, ok
268	}
269	
270	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
271	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
272		if e == nil {
273			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
274		}
275		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
276			return err
277		}
278		if e.Locations == nil {
279			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
280		}
281		e.Locations[host] = location
282		return nil
283	}
284	
285	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
286	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
287		clone := e
288		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
289		if e.Experiment != nil {
290			value := *e.Experiment
291			clone.Experiment = &value
292		}
293		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
294			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
295			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
296		}
297		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
298			value := *e.MoveIntent
299			clone.MoveIntent = &value
300		}
301		if e.Locations != nil {
302			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
303			for host, location := range e.Locations {
304				clone.Locations[host] = location
305			}
306		}
307		return &clone
308	}
309	
310	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
311	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
312	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
313		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
314			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
315		}
316		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
317			return err
318		}
319		switch e.Kind {
320		case KindTry:
321			if e.Experiment == nil {
322				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
323			}
324		case KindRepository:
325		default:
326			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
327		}
328		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
329			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
```

```text
1	package cli

10	)
11	
12	// joinRepoAssets matches a discovery snapshot without persisting every repo.
13	// complete is false when unreadable catalog records could make a negative or
14	// duplicate match unsafe to act on.
15	func joinRepoAssets(app *App, repos []repo.Repo) (assets []*catalog.Entry, complete bool, err error) {
16		assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(repos))
17		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil {
18			return assets, true, nil
19		}
20		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
21		if err != nil {
22			app.warnf("could not read catalog metadata: %v; leaving repository rows unsuppressed", err)
23			return assets, false, nil
24		}
25		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
26			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
27		}
28		complete = len(diagnostics) == 0
29		host := configHostname()
30		for index, repository := range repos {
31			var matches []*catalog.Entry
32			for _, entry := range entries {
33				location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
34				if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
35					continue
36				}
37				if repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
38					matches = append(matches, entry)
39				}
40			}
41			catalog.Sort(matches)
42			switch len(matches) {
43			case 1:
44				assets[index] = matches[0].Clone()
45			case 0:
46			default:
47				ids := make([]string, len(matches))
48				for i, entry := range matches {
49					ids[i] = entry.ID
50				}
51				sort.Strings(ids)
52				app.warnf("repository %s matches multiple catalog assets (%v); leaving it unsuppressed", repository.Path, ids)
53			}
54		}
55		return assets, complete, nil
56	}
57	
58	func repoLocationMatches(repository repo.Repo, location catalog.Location) bool {
59		repositoryPaths := canonicalRepoValues(repository.Path, repository.RealPath)
60		locationPaths := canonicalRepoValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath)
61		for value := range repositoryPaths {
62			if _, ok := locationPaths[value]; ok {
63				return true
64			}
65		}
66		common := canonicalRepoValue(repository.CommonDir)
67		return common != "" && common == canonicalRepoValue(location.GitCommonDir)
68	}
69	
70	func canonicalRepoValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
71		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
72		for _, value := range values {
73			if canonical := canonicalRepoValue(value); canonical != "" {
74				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
75			}
76		}
77		return out
78	}
79	
80	func canonicalRepoValue(value string) string {
81		if value == "" {
82			return ""
83		}
84		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
85		if err != nil {
86			return ""
87		}
88		return canonical
89	}
90	
91	func suppressTryRepo(entry *catalog.Entry, catalogComplete bool) bool {
92		if entry == nil || !catalogComplete || entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
93			return false
94		}
95		return entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated
96	}
97	
98	func configHostname() string {
99		// Kept behind a function to make every matching call visibly host-scoped.
100		return config.Hostname()
101	}
102
```

```text
1281	// visibleRepos applies the text query, and sorts repositories with work in
1282	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking
1283	// for, not alphabetical order.
1284	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1285		var out []RepoRow
1286		for _, r := range m.repos {
1287			if r.IsTry() || !r.matches(m.filter) {
1288				continue
1289			}
1290			out = append(out, r)
1291		}
1292		sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1293		if sortBy == "" {
1294			sortBy = "activity"
1295		}
1296		sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
1297			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1298			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1299				return cmp > 0
1300			}
1301			return cmp < 0
1302		})
1303		return applyColumnSort(m, out, repoCell)
1304	}

1306	// visibleTries applies structured experiment filters and keeps sorting local to
1307	// the view so repository ordering remains independent.

1309		out := make([]TryRow, 0, len(m.tries))

1318		}
1319		sortTryRows(out, sortBy, m.tryReverse)
1320		return applyColumnSort(m, out, tryCell)
1321	}

1323	type repoItem struct {
1324		Repo          RepoRow
1325		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
1326	}
1327	
1328	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
1329	
1330	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
1331		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
1332			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
1333		}
1334		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
1335	}
1336	
1337	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1338	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1339	// from the repository they belong to.
1340	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1341		repos := m.visibleRepos()
1342		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
1343		for _, r := range repos {
1344			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
1345			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
1346				continue
1347			}
1348			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
1349				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1350			}
1351		}
1352		return out
1353	}
1354
```

```text
1607	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1608	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1609		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1610		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1611			switch {
1612			case x > y:
1613				return -1
1614			case x < y:
1615				return 1
1616			default:
1617				return 0
1618			}
1619		}
1620		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1621			if x == y {
1622				return 0
1623			}
1624			if x {
1625				return -1
1626			}
1627			return 1
1628		}
1629		latest := func() int {
1630			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1631				return 0
1632			}
1633			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1634				return -1
1635			}
1636			return 1
1637		}
1638	
1639		switch sortBy {
1640		case "name":
1641			return nameCmp
1642		case "latest":
1643			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1644				return c
1645			}
1646		case "git":
1647			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1648				return c
1649			}
1650			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1651				return c
1652			}
1653		case "size":
1654			switch {
1655			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1656				return -1
1657			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1658				return 1
1659			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1660				return -1
1661			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1662				return 1
1663			}
1664		case "tasks":
1665			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1666				return c
1667			}
1668			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1669				return c
1670			}
1671		default: // activity
1672			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1673				return c
1674			}
1675			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1676				return c
1677			}
1678			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1679				return c
1680			}
1681			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1682				return c
1683			}
1684			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1685				return c
1686			}
1687		}
1688		return nameCmp
1689	}
1690
```

```text
207	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
208		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
209			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
210		}
211		seen := map[string]bool{}
212		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
213		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
214		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
215		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
216		identities := map[string]bool{}
217		var out []Repo
218	
219		for _, root := range roots {
220			info, err := os.Stat(root)
221			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
222				if opts.OnError != nil && err != nil {
223					opts.OnError(root, err)
224				}
225				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
226			}
227			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
228	
229			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
230				if err != nil {
231					if opts.OnError != nil {
232						opts.OnError(path, err)
233					}
234					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
235				}
236				if ctx.Err() != nil {
237					return ctx.Err()
238				}
239				isRoot := path == rootClean
240				name := d.Name()
241				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
242				isDir := d.IsDir()
243				if isLink {
244					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
245					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
246					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
247					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
248						isDir = info.IsDir()
249					}
250				}
251				if !isDir {
252					return nil
253				}
254				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
255					return filepath.SkipDir
256				}
257	
258				rel := "."
259				depth := 0
260				if !isRoot {
261					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
262					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
263				}
264	
265				if isRepoDir(path) {
266					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
267					if real == "" {
268						real = path
269					}
270					bare := isBareDir(path)
271					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
272					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
273						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
274						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
275						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
276						return filepath.SkipDir
277					}
278	
279					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
280						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
281						out = append(out, Repo{
282							Name:      name,
283							Path:      path,
284							RealPath:  real,
285							Symlink:   isLink,
286							Root:      rootClean,
287							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
288							GitDir:    gitDir,
289							CommonDir: commonDir,
290							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
291							Bare:      bare,
292							HasGit:    true,
293						})
294					}
295					if opts.OnCandidate != nil && !gitEntryIsFile(path) {
296						category := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel))
297						if category == "." {
298							category = ""
299						}
300						opts.OnCandidate(Repo{Name: name, Path: path, RealPath: real, Root: rootClean, Category: category, HasGit: true, Bare: bare})
301					}
302					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
303					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
304					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
305					return filepath.SkipDir
306				}
307				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
308					return filepath.SkipDir
309				}
310				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
311					if !seen[path] {
312						seen[path] = true
313						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
314					}
315				}
316				return nil
317			})
318			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
319				return out, ctx.Err()
320			}
321		}
322	
323		if !opts.Fast {
324			workers := min(max(1, opts.Workers), 8)
325			jobs := make(chan int)
326			linked := make([]bool, len(out))
327			var wg sync.WaitGroup
328			for n := 0; n < workers; n++ {
329				wg.Go(func() {
330					for i := range jobs {
331						r := &out[i]
332						if !r.HasGit || r.Bare {
333							continue
334						}
335						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, r.Path); err == nil {
336							linked[i] = g.IsLinkedWorktree
337							r.GitDir, r.CommonDir, r.MainRoot, r.RealPath = g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot, g.MainRoot
338						}
339					}
340				})
341			}
342			for i := range out {
343				jobs <- i
344			}
345			close(jobs)
346			wg.Wait()
347			if ctx.Err() != nil {
348				return nil, ctx.Err()
349			}
350			accepted := make([]Repo, 0, len(out))
351			ids := map[string]bool{}
352			for i, r := range out {
353				key := r.CommonDir
354				if key == "" {
355					key = r.Path
356				}
357				if linked[i] || ids[key] {
358					continue
359				}
360				ids[key] = true
361				accepted = append(accepted, r)
362			}
363			out = accepted
364		}
365	
366		for i := range out {
367			if out[i].Category == "." {
368				out[i].Category = ""
369			}
370		}
371		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
372			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
373				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
374			}
375			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
376		})
377		return out, nil
378	}
```

```text
1	package repo

3	import (
4		"context"

8		"os"
9		"path/filepath"
10		"time"

12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
14	)
15	
16	// CachedRow holds presentation only: no task, runtime or action authority.
17	type CachedRow struct {
18		Repo         Repo
19		Status       gitx.Status
20		GitKnown     bool
21		LastActivity time.Time
22		Try          bool
23	}
24	type Snapshot struct {
25		Version     int
26		Fingerprint [32]byte
27		ObservedAt  time.Time
28		Rows        []CachedRow
29	}
30	
31	func SnapshotKey(roots []string, state string) [32]byte {
32		data, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
33			Roots []string
34			State string
35		}{roots, state})
36		return sha256.Sum256(data)
37	}
38	func ReadSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, key [32]byte) (Snapshot, error) {
39		data, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, path, 8<<20)
40		if err != nil {
41			return Snapshot{}, err
42		}
43		var snapshot Snapshot
44		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
45			return Snapshot{}, err
46		}
47		if snapshot.Version != 1 || snapshot.Fingerprint != key || snapshot.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
48			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("repository cache does not match this discovery configuration")
49		}
50		for _, r := range snapshot.Rows {
51			if !filepath.IsAbs(r.Repo.Path) || r.Repo.Name == "" {
52				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("invalid cached repository")
53			}
54		}
55		return snapshot, nil
56	}
57	func WriteSnapshot(path string, snapshot Snapshot) error {
58		snapshot.Version = 1
59		data, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
60		if err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		if len(data) > 8<<20 {
64			return errors.New("repository cache exceeds 8 MiB")
65		}
66		if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
67			return err
68		}
69		file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".repos-*")
70		if err != nil {
71			return err
72		}
73		defer os.Remove(file.Name())
74		if _, err = file.Write(data); err != nil {
75			file.Close()
76			return err
77		}
78		if err = file.Close(); err != nil {
79			return err
80		}
81		return os.Rename(file.Name(), path)
82	}
```

```text
42	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the

71	}
72	
73	// List returns every readable catalog entry and reports skipped records through
74	// the Store's configured diagnostic sink.
75	func (r *Registry) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
76		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
77			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
78		}
79		return r.store.List()
80	}
81	
82	// Get loads one entry by stable catalog ID.
83	func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
84		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
85			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
86		}
87		return r.store.Get(id)
88	}
89	
90	// Update applies an atomic mutation to one entry.
91	func (r *Registry) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
92		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
93			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
94		}
95		r.mu.Lock()
96		defer r.mu.Unlock()
97		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
98	}
99	
100	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
101	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
102	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
103	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
104		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
109		return entry, err
110	}
111	
112	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
113	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
114	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
115	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
116		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
121			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
122		}
123	
124		r.mu.Lock()
125		defer r.mu.Unlock()
126		var result *Entry
127		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
128			matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
129			if matchErr == nil {
130				result, matchErr = r.attachUnderLock(matched.ID, normalized)
131				return matchErr
132			}
133			if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
134				return matchErr
135			}
136	
137			entry := &Entry{
138				Kind:           KindRepository,
139				Name:           normalized.Name,
140				RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
141				Locations: map[string]Location{
142					normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
143				},
144			}
145			if err := r.store.CreateUnderLock(entry); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			result = entry.Clone()
149			return nil
150		})
151		return result, err
152	}
153	
154	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
155	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
156		return r.Update(id, mutate)
157	}
158	
159	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
160	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
161	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
162	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
163		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, err
166		}
167		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
168			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
169		}
170		r.mu.Lock()
171		defer r.mu.Unlock()
172		var result *Entry
173		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
174			var attachErr error
175			result, attachErr = r.attachUnderLock(id, normalized)
176			return attachErr
177		})
178		return result, err
179	}
180
```

```text
261	func patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, add, remove []string, note *string) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
262		commonDir := repository.CommonDir
263		realPath := repository.RealPath
264		if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path); discoverErr == nil {
265			if commonDir == "" {
266				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
267			}
268			if realPath == "" {
269				realPath = discovered.Root
270			}
271		}
272		observation := catalog.Observation{
273			Host: config.Hostname(), Path: repository.Path, RealPath: realPath,
274			CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
275			RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
276		}
277		add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
278		remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
279		entry, err := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, err
282		}
283		return app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
284			kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
285			for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
286				if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
287					kept = append(kept, tag)
288				}
289			}
290			candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
291			if note != nil {
292				candidate.Note = *note
293			}
294			return nil
295		})
296	}
```

```text
13	
14	const tuiTraceEnv = "DEV_TUI_TRACE"
15	
16	func traceFromEnvironment() (*perftrace.Recorder, string, error) {
17		path := os.Getenv(tuiTraceEnv)
18		if path == "" {
19			return nil, "", nil
20		}
21		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
22			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s must name an absolute, non-existing file", tuiTraceEnv)
23		}
24		path = filepath.Clean(path)
25		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
26			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists: %s", tuiTraceEnv, path)
27		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
28			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("inspect %s: %w", tuiTraceEnv, err)
29		}
30		parent, err := os.Stat(filepath.Dir(path))
31		if err != nil {
32			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("inspect %s parent: %w", tuiTraceEnv, err)
33		}
34		if !parent.IsDir() {
35			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s parent is not a directory", tuiTraceEnv)
36		}
37		return perftrace.New(perftrace.DefaultLimit), path, nil
38	}
39	
40	// finishTrace freezes background producers before writing the one-shot trace.
41	// It is safe to call both immediately after Bubble Tea and from Execute's defer.
42	func (a *App) finishTrace() {
43		if a == nil {
44			return
45		}
46		if a.traceOnce == nil {
47			a.traceOnce = &sync.Once{}
48		}
49		a.traceOnce.Do(func() {
50			if a.trace == nil || a.tracePath == "" || !a.traceTUI {
51				return
52			}
53			if err := perftrace.WriteNew(a.tracePath, a.trace.Freeze()); err != nil {
54				writer := a.Err
55				if writer == nil {
56					writer = os.Stderr
57				}
58				fmt.Fprintf(writer, "dev: warning: performance trace: %v\n", err)
59			}
60		})
61	}
```

```text
492	
493	## Progressive loading, searchable actions and yearly activity
494	
495	REPOS first reads a dated presentation cache, then publishes discovery and Git
496	observations incrementally. A slow runtime does not hold back repository rows.
497	Pending/cached rows grant no authority for row-dependent actions. The new-repo
498	wizard is an independent entry point and retains its final mutation checks.
499	Only complete discovery removes missing rows; failures retain stale/unknown
500	evidence. `r` remains local refresh; `dev self cache clear repos` removes the snapshot.
501	SIZE retains its separate cache.
502	
503	Ctrl+O menus and submenus support `/` filtering, arrows and Enter; Escape clears
504	search before closing. `H` displays saved stats, then automatically backfills the
505	selected repository's full local Git history. Unchanged refs reuse a checkpoint.
506	Calendar years run oldest first, with wheel/arrows, PgUp/PgDn and Home/End
507	scrolling; narrow screens split into week segments. `r` refreshes and `b` forces
508	backfill without fetching. Git activity is still a 20-minute estimate per
509	non-merge commit.
510	
511	The REPOS/SKILLS action menu opens the independent
512	[Skills management wizard](skills-management.md) for scopes, selection, checks
513	and reviewed mutations; it is not another dashboard tab.
514	
515	
516	### Local loading measurement
517	
518	A 60-repository isolated fixture, three runs per case on macOS with Go 1.26.4,
519	measured the following medians. These are trace acceptance times, not terminal
520	rasterization; all live Git reads still finish in the background.
521	
522	| Case | First repository data | Complete local snapshot |
523	|---|---:|---:|
524	| Previous dashboard | 3,896 ms | 3,896 ms |
525	| New, no presentation cache | 14 ms | 3,911 ms |
526	| New, presentation cache | 15 ms | 2,819 ms |
527	
528	The first display no longer waits for a full scan. Full-scan duration remains
529	sensitive to filesystem/process load; this change does not claim cached Git
530	facts are current. Recovery details are loaded for the focused repository, and
531	completed rows become available while other repositories are still loading.
```

```text
463		if h.worktreeSource != nil {

465		}
466		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "-C", path, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")

469			return ""
470		}
471		var parent string
472		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {

475				parent = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))

478					return filepath.Clean(parent)
479				}
480				return ""
481			}
482		}
483		return ""
484	}
```

```text
642	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
643		var result *Entry
644		err := s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
645			var err error
646			result, err = s.UpdateUnderLock(id, mutate)
647			return err
648		})
649		return result, err
650	}
651	
652	// UpdateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
653	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
654	func (s *Store) UpdateUnderLock(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
655		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
656			return nil, err
657		}
658		if mutate == nil {
659			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
660		}
661		current, err := s.get(id)
662		if err != nil {
663			return nil, err
664		}
665		updated := current.Clone()
666		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
667			return nil, err
668		}
669		if updated.ID != current.ID {
670			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
671		}
672		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
673			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
674		}
675		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
676			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
677		}
678		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
679			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
680		}
681	
682		now := s.now()
683		updated.Updated = now
684		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
685		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
686		updated.Normalize()
687		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
688			return nil, err
689		}
690		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
691			return nil, err
692		}
693		return updated.Clone(), nil
694	}
```

## 結論

目前已有 **REPOS 快取＋漸進式載入**，但「能看見 repository」與「能按 Enter 開啟」仍被綁在一起。最小改善應拆成兩部分：

1. **純導航不等全量 Git／runtime inventory**，改為只驗證選中的 checkout。
2. **收藏持久化、置頂與優先載入**，沿用 catalog 身分與現有載入管線。

只加入 favorite 排序，無法解決目前的等待。

全程僅閱讀程式碼與測試；未執行 dev、測試、實際 repository 掃描或修改檔案。

## 1. 精確呼叫鏈與等待位置

### 啟動與初始載入

```text
root RunE / tui RunE
→ runTUI
→ 建立 runtimeResolver、localLoader、Actions
→ tui.New(...).BeginLoading()
→ tea.Program.Run()
→ Model.Init()
→ reload()
→ startLocalLoad()
→ tuiLocalLoader.Start()
```

主要證據：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/root.go:109`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/tui.go:302–315, 542, 740–751`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/model.go:583–642, 931–934`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/local.go:51–78`

`Start()` 建立 futures／goroutines 後即回傳結果 channel，不在 `Init()` 內同步等完整掃描。它並行啟動：

- task store 讀取；
- runtime resolve＋`rt.List()`；
- REPOS 快取讀取與 discovery。

因此此版本的主要問題不是「首畫面前同步掃描」，而是後續的資料依賴與 action guard。

### REPOS progressive pipeline

`/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/tui_load.go:73–152, 165–192, 207–271`

| 階段 | 發出的 row | 是否可以開啟 |
|---|---|---|
| presentation cache | `Pending: "cached"` | 否 |
| filesystem candidate | `Pending: "loading"` | 否 |
| Git/context enrichment，runtime 尚未完成 | `Pending: "runtime pending"` | 否 |
| enrichment 當下 runtime 已完成 | `Pending: ""` | 可以，不必等其餘 repositories |
| 最終 REPOS snapshot | 完整 rows | 可以 |

**關鍵 barrier**：enrichment producer 在 `repositories.wait(ctx)` 後才開始，見 `tui_load.go:233–248`。

而 `repo.Discover()` 本身先走完所有 roots，再對候選 repositories 做 Git identity discovery、去重與排序後回傳：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/repo/discover.go:207–321`：逐 root `WalkDir`，提早發 `OnCandidate`。
- 同檔 `323–377`：最多八個 Git discovery workers，全部完成後才回傳。

enrichment 再做 catalog join、notes、task/context、worktrees、status、activity 等：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/tui.go:1052–1180`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/inventory/repo_context.go:395–429, 504–539, 625–629`

目前以共享八個名額的 limiter 控制 TASKS／REPOS enrichment。程式中的「56 repos／4.2s」是既有歷史量測註解，不是本次量測。

**另一個實際延遲來源**：某列先以 `runtime pending` 發出後，runtime 完成不會立即重新發布該列；要到所有 repo enrichment 完成後，才一起 join runtime 並發最終 snapshot，見 `tui_load.go:174–185, 248–271`。

### Refresh

```text
r
→ listActionRefresh
→ reloadConfig()
→ configMsg
→ beginLocalLoads(loadConfig)
→ reloadAfterConfig()
→ startLocalLoad()
```

證據：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/action_shortcuts.go:9–57`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/model.go:1203–1224, 2830–2886`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/readiness.go:86–139`

每次 REPOS generation 開始，既有所有 rows 都被標成 `Pending: "refreshing"`，所以原本能開啟的列在 refresh 中也再次被擋。一般 REPOS 沒有在此看到獨立的週期性 timer；背景載入主要來自啟動、明確 refresh、設定與操作後刷新。

## 2. 搜尋、選取、Enter 與 Herdr handoff

- **搜尋中的第一次 Enter 只離開搜尋框，不開啟；第二次 Enter 才開啟。**

## 3. 純 open 真正應保留哪些 guard

現有一般 repo callback 只使用 `Repo.Path`／`Name`，沒有使用 dirty、task counts、GitKnown、topology 或已掃描的 runtime sessions。

建議最小放寬範圍：

- **僅對 REPOS `listActionOpen` 放寬 Pending guard**；同步改鍵盤提前 guard 與 registry，避免兩套行為。
- 保留 callback availability。
- 保留精確 parent／child 選取與 selection token。
- child checkout 保留 missing／prunable 判斷；實際執行時對選中 checkout 做新鮮驗證。
- 從 cache／candidate 開啟前，新增 bounded、target-only 的路徑存在／目錄／Git identity 驗證，避免直接將舊 cache 當真。
- 不需要為純導航等待全機 task、runtime inventory、status、size 或 recovery topology。
- 不要順便放寬 start、cleanup、filtered batch、clone 等需要完整觀測／身分的操作。

注意目前 `OpenRepo`／`openResolved` **沒有獨立 `os.Stat`／repository identity validation**；若直接刪掉 guard，不能聲稱已經有等價安全檢查。

可重用 focus helpers：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/list_actions.go:157–169, 194–214, 257–279`
- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/repo_progress.go:71–108`

selected-row topology 已是獨立背景工作，不是 open 必要條件：

- `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/repo_topology.go:80–102`

## 5. 建議的最小擴充邊界

1. **先解耦導航 readiness**  
   保留觀測顯示為 pending/stale，只讓 plain open 做 target-only validation 後導航。不要靠清空 `Pending` 假裝觀測已完成。

2. **收藏 durable state 留在 catalog**  
   最小 schema-free 版本可約定一個 tag；若要正式 favorite 語意，新增獨立 bool 與窄化 mutation API 較清楚。不要把收藏的唯一資料放入 disposable snapshot。

3. **favorite 排序在所有普通排序之上**  
   `applyColumnSort()` 在最後，單改 `compareRepos()` 會被欄位排序蓋過；應先完成既有排序，再穩定分成 favorite／其他群組，或讓兩層 comparator 共用優先規則。children 維持跟隨 parent。

4. **優先 refresh 必須改 producer，不只是 UI sort**  
   現有 roots 順序可以影響候選發現，但 full discovery barrier 仍存在；enrichment 又是每列開 goroutine 搶 limiter，僅重排 slice 不保證執行優先序。  
   最小可行方向是在 loader 中先讀 durable favorites／已知路徑，做 targeted discovery/enrichment，再接原有全量流；或建立明確 priority work queue。不要為收藏偷偷修改 `scan_roots/repo_paths`。

5. **沿用 generation／merge／focus 規則**  
   late cache、舊 generation 不可覆蓋新資料；partial failure 不可刪除未回報的收藏；favorite mutation 最好回傳局部 patch，而不是用泛用 `actionMsg` 觸發又一輪全量 refresh。

# dev-cli

Git owns durable code; worktrees are local checkouts; runtimes are host-local
sessions; dev records task intent.

## Discover what you need

Use leaf `--help` for syntax, `dev help <topic>` for workflows, and
`dev help --tree` for families. See [navigation](references/command-navigation.md)
for shortcuts and Try graduation/demotion; dashboard details: `dev help tui`.
Prefer supported JSON. Read help before mutation: some actions apply immediately,
others require preview/apply. Do not preload manuals or run routine diagnostics.

## Preserve these boundaries

- Opening needs no task. Select direct, branch or worktree deliberately; use
  explicit `--base`. Managed worktrees stay outside repositories.
- Task-free worktrees use `dev git worktree create/open`; cleanup stays reviewed.
  `dev repo list --json` supplies navigation candidates, not external preferences/history.
- `dev work start` prepares checkout/runtime; agent launch is explicit. Parallel
  writers require disjoint ownership and verified targets.
- Completion, artifacts, retirement and branch deletion are separate. Finalize
  after writer exit; retire externally. Use `retire --base` when integration is unproven.
- Cached/unknown observations, runtime `done` and merged PRs never authorize
  cleanup. Resolve guards; never improvise force removal or bypass checks.
- `dev pr checkout <URL>` is task-free; `--try` creates an independent clone.
  Provisioning is explicit; merge never cleans up locally.

## Read a reference for advanced operations

- Worktrees/lifecycle: [ownership](references/worktree-ownership.md), [lifecycle](references/task-lifecycle.md).
- Agents/prompts: [agents](references/parallel-agents.md), [handoffs](references/prompt-handoffs.md).
- History retention, exact sessions and co-commit: [artifacts](references/ai-artifacts.md).
- Cleanup: [retirement](references/agent-retirement.md), [triage](references/local-triage.md).
- Hygiene/scans/redaction: [hygiene](references/hygiene.md).
- Forks/setup/organization: [setup](references/repository-bootstrap.md), [bootstrap](references/bootstrap.md).
- SSH/fleet: [SSH](references/ssh-hosts.md).
- Dotfile setup, native chezmoi operations, or FLEET host actions: [dotfiles](references/dotfiles.md).
- Skill/MCP/instruction transfers, updates or removal: [transfers](references/agent-interop.md), [maintenance](references/skills-management.md).
- [Snippets](references/snippets.md).
- PR/MR pages, diffnav, gh-dash, checkout and merge: [pull requests](references/pull-requests.md).
- Recursive Git children: [submodules](references/submodules.md).

## Unexpected dev failures

Read [feedback and repair](references/feedback-and-repair.md). Preserve the
original task; extra investigation, repair, subagents and publication need
explicit consent covering scope and cost.

```text
90	// Update applies an atomic mutation to one entry.
91	func (r *Registry) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
92		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
93			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
94		}
95		r.mu.Lock()
96		defer r.mu.Unlock()
97		return r.store.Update(id, mutate)
98	}
99	
100	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
101	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
102	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
103	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
104		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
109		return entry, err
110	}
111	
112	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
113	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
114	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
115	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
116		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
121			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
122		}
123	
124		r.mu.Lock()
125		defer r.mu.Unlock()
126		var result *Entry
127		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
128			matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
129			if matchErr == nil {
130				result, matchErr = r.attachUnderLock(matched.ID, normalized)
131				return matchErr
132			}
133			if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
134				return matchErr
135			}
136	
137			entry := &Entry{
138				Kind:           KindRepository,
139				Name:           normalized.Name,
140				RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
141				Locations: map[string]Location{
142					normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
143				},
144			}
145			if err := r.store.CreateUnderLock(entry); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			result = entry.Clone()
149			return nil
150		})
151		return result, err
152	}
153	
154	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
155	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
```

```text
15	func joinRepoAssets(app *App, repos []repo.Repo) (assets []*catalog.Entry, complete bool, err error) {
16		assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(repos))
17		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil {
18			return assets, true, nil
19		}
20		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
21		if err != nil {
22			app.warnf("could not read catalog metadata: %v; leaving repository rows unsuppressed", err)
23			return assets, false, nil
24		}
25		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
26			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
27		}
28		complete = len(diagnostics) == 0
29		host := configHostname()
30		for index, repository := range repos {
31			var matches []*catalog.Entry
32			for _, entry := range entries {
33				location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
34				if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
```

```text
261	func patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, add, remove []string, note *string) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
262		commonDir := repository.CommonDir
263		realPath := repository.RealPath
264		if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path); discoverErr == nil {
265			if commonDir == "" {
266				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
267			}
268			if realPath == "" {
269				realPath = discovered.Root
270			}
271		}
272		observation := catalog.Observation{
273			Host: config.Hostname(), Path: repository.Path, RealPath: realPath,
274			CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
275			RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
276		}
277		add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
278		remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
279		entry, err := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, err
282		}
283		return app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
284			kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
285			for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
286				if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
287					kept = append(kept, tag)
288				}
289			}
290			candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
291			if note != nil {
292				candidate.Note = *note
293			}
294			return nil
295		})
296	}
```

```text
101	func PathDiscoverableFromRoot(root, candidate string, opts Options) (bool, error) {
102		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
103			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
104		}
105		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(root)
106		if err != nil {
107			return false, err

109		canonicalCandidate, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate)
110		if err != nil {
111			return false, err

113		absoluteRoot, err := filepath.Abs(root)
114		if err != nil {
115			return false, err
116		}
117		if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(absoluteRoot); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && canonicalCandidate != canonicalRoot {
118			// WalkDir can inspect a symlinked root itself, but it never follows that
119			// symlink into child repositories.
120			return false, nil
121		}
122		if alias, err := discoverableSymlinkAlias(absoluteRoot, canonicalCandidate, opts); err != nil || alias {
123			return alias, err
124		}
125		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
126		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
127			return false, nil
128		}
129		if rel == "." {
130			return true, nil
131		}
132		components := strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator))
133		if len(components) > opts.MaxDepth {
134			return false, nil
135		}
136		for _, component := range components {
137			if skipDirs[component] || (strings.HasPrefix(component, ".") && component != ".bare") {
138				return false, nil
139			}
140		}
141		return true, nil
142	}
```

```text
8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
10		for _, row := range updates {
11			found := false
12			for i, old := range rows {
13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path {
14					if row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" {
15						found = true
16						break
17					}
18					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
19						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
20					}
21					if row.Usage == nil {
22						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
23					}
24					rows[i] = row
25					found = true
26					break
27				}
28			}
29			if !found {
30				rows = append(rows, row)
31			}
32		}
33		return rows
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
37		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
38		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
39			return m, false
40		}
41		phase := 1
42		if result.Phase != "cache" {
43			phase = 2
44		}
45		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
46			return m, false
47		}
48		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
49		token := m.currentToken()
50		path := m.repoFocusPath()
51		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
52		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
53		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
54		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
55		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
56		if phase == 1 {
57			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
58		}
59		count := len(m.repos)
60		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
61		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
62		if phase == 1 && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
63			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
64		}
65		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
66		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
67		m.setAt(m.at())
68		return m, true
69	}
70	
71	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
72		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
73			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
74				return checkout.Worktree.Path
75			}
76			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
77		}
78		return ""
79	}
80	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
81		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
82			return
83		}
84		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
85			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
86			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
87				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
88			}
89			if candidate == path {
90				m.setAt(i)
91				return
92			}
93		}
94	}
95	
96	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
97		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
98		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
99		for _, row := range rows {
100			for _, candidate := range merged {
101				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path {
102					out = append(out, candidate)
103					break
104				}
105			}
106		}
107		return out
108	}
```

```text
24	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
25	// much of it is currently in flight.
26	//
27	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
28	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
29	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
30	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
31	// RepoActions groups catalog metadata mutations for ordinary repositories.
32	type RepoActions struct {
33		Create func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
34		Patch  func(ctx context.Context, row RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error)
35	}
36	
37	type RepoRow struct {
38		TopologyPending bool
39		Pending         string
40		GitKnown        bool
41		ObservedAt      time.Time
42		Repo            repo.Repo

45		TopologyErr     error
46		SizeTarget      diskusage.Target
47		Usage           *diskusage.Usage
48		SizeError       error
49		// Asset is catalog metadata joined without persisting an otherwise
50		// unobserved repository. A Try asset lets callers suppress or label it.
51		Asset *catalog.Entry
52		// Context is the canonical checkout plus every linked worktree, enriched
53		// with task and runtime state. It is shared by the tree, copy actions and
54		// `dev repo context`, so those surfaces cannot disagree.
55		Context inventory.RepoContext
56		// LastActivity is the newest commit time in this checkout. It is a durable,
57		// cheap approximation of "when was this repo last touched" and is sortable.
58		LastActivity time.Time
59		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
60		Worktrees int
61		// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
62		Tasks []*task.Task
63		// NoteCount/LatestNote are joined from the durable sidecar store when this
64		// repo already has a catalog identity.
65		NoteCount  int
66		LatestNote *note.Note
67		// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
68		Live          bool
69		Runtime       string
70		RuntimeHandle string
71		RuntimeStatus string
72		// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
73		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
74		RemoteForge forge.Kind

76	}
77	
78	// Sessions returns every runtime session attached to any checkout in this

81	
82	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
83	// IsTry reports an ungraduated Try that should live in the dedicated TRY view,
84	// while remaining in the model's local snapshot for REMOTE matching.
85	func (r RepoRow) IsTry() bool {
86		return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Kind == catalog.KindTry && r.Asset.Experiment != nil &&
87			(r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated)

93			if t.State == task.Hot {
94				n++
95			}
96		}
97		return n
98	}

100	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
101	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
102	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
103		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
104			return ""
105		}
106		counts := map[task.State]int{}
107		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
108			counts[t.State]++
109		}
110		var parts []string
111		for _, s := range task.States {
112			if counts[s] > 0 {
113				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
114			}
115		}
116		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
117	}
```

```text
419	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
420		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
421			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
422				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
423				if real == "" {
424					real = g.MainRoot
425				}
426				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
427				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
428				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
429				return Repo{
430					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
431					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
432				}, nil, nil
433			}
434		}
435		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
436		if err != nil {
437			return Repo{}, nil, err
438		}
439		for _, r := range all {
440			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
441				return r, nil, nil
442			}
443		}
444		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
445		var hits []Repo
446		for _, r := range all {
447			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
448				hits = append(hits, r)
449			}
450		}
451		switch len(hits) {
452		case 1:
453			return hits[0], nil, nil
454		case 0:
455			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
456		default:
457			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
458		}
459	}
460	
461	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
462	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
463	
464	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
```

## Feasibility

This can stay scoped to REPOS: add durable favorites, a favorite-first loading path, and a narrowly validated plain-open exception. The evidence explains an avoidable scan dependency; it does **not** establish how much latency comes from Herdr itself.

### 1. Persist one favorite flag

- Add `Asset.Favorite bool` and `Patch.Favorite *bool`; absent means false. Treat “star” and “pin” as one feature, not separate ordering systems.
- Reuse `RepoActions.Patch` → `patchRepositoryCatalog` → `EnsureRepository` / `Registry.Patch`. Only explicit user action creates an uncataloged repository asset; scanning remains read-only.
- Expose a parent-repository toggle through the existing action registry. Preserve existing non-open readiness gates; no CLI expansion, recency tracking, or synchronization.
- Return a dedicated favorite-result message, **not** generic `actionMsg` that triggers a full reload. Serialize mutations per asset and update the current catalog overlay by stable asset ID.

### 2. Make plain-open independent of inventory completion

- Permit only `listActionOpen` while a REPOS row is pending, consistently across keyboard and action-menu gates. Do not clear `Pending`; preserve every other action gate and missing/prunable child restrictions.
- Extend the open request beyond `Path`/`Name` to carry expected repository identity and, where applicable, the selected child checkout identity.
- Before `openResolved`, perform fresh, target-only validation: directory existence, canonical checkout root, Git common-directory identity, and child membership/availability. Reject missing, mismatched, or ambiguous targets without quitting the TUI.
- Validation must not wait behind the inventory work queue, full discovery, task enumeration, or global runtime `List`. Still resolve the required runtime and retain selected-target checks inside `OpenWorktree`.
- Preserve the existing successful-open handoff: quit, cancel the loader, then activate the runtime without joining the whole scan. A failed open leaves discovery running.
- Preserve search behavior explicitly: **first Enter exits filtering; second Enter opens**.

### 3. Refresh favorites before full discovery finishes

Add a small favorite producer beside the existing discovery future rather than redesigning all discovery.

1. Read catalog favorites for the current host and apply the existing configured discovery-scope/exclusion rules.
2. Publish provisional favorite rows with honest pending state.
3. Validate and enrich those targets without awaiting the full `Discover` result.
4. Feed favorite and ordinary REPOS work through a bounded dispatcher with explicit favorite-first admission. Keep the existing enrichment budget; launching goroutines in sorted order is insufficient.
5. Deduplicate favorite/full-discovery results using validated identity. Publish each favorite independently, and rejoin already-enriched rows when runtime observations become available—not after all unrelated enrichment finishes.

Priority means job admission, not guaranteed completion order or preemption of already-running work.

### 4. Preserve identity, preferences, and presentation

- Maintain catalog preference state separately from scan observations. Late cache, enrichment, and final snapshots must not overwrite a successful favorite toggle.
- Apply inventory generation checks and catalog preference updates independently: a completed mutation should update the currently bound asset even if scanning restarted.
- Partial snapshots cannot delete favorites. A confirmed missing target retains its durable favorite and appears unavailable within the applicable scope; a different repository at that path must not silently inherit it.
- Filter normally, perform both existing sorts, then **stable-partition parent groups** into favorites and others. Preserve selected sort/reverse within each group and keep children attached.
- Restore focus using existing identity helpers, not the previous row index.

### 5. Lock down the behavior with focused tests

Use barrier-controlled fake scanners and runtime providers, with no sleeps:

- Hold discovery and global runtime listing open; prove validated plain-open proceeds.
- Prove missing/reused targets and missing/prunable children remain blocked.
- Hold unrelated enrichment open; prove favorites start and publish first, including runtime-ready updates.
- Cover persistence/default false, explicit catalog creation only, metadata preservation, stale generations/cache, mutation during refresh, and partial snapshots.
- Cover favorites under reverse/column sorting, filtering, child grouping, cursor retention, keyboard/menu parity, and the two-Enter convention.

Revise pending-authority help only for the navigation exception, plus the paired bootstrap guides, README, embedded skill references, and Unreleased entry under existing documentation conventions. Later reproduction can use `DEV_TUI_TRACE`; no timing improvement is claimed yet.

## Decisions and risks to settle

- **Identity at reused paths:** the current join accepts path equality alone. Even canonical path plus common-directory path cannot reliably distinguish a same-path replacement. Recommend a minimal host-local Git-directory identity witness captured during explicit binding, with deliberate revalidation/rebinding for unverifiable legacy records. Do not promise replacement detection from path checks alone.
- **Preference scope:** additive `Favorite` makes the preference asset-wide, while visibility and refresh remain current-host/current-scope. Confirm that semantics before implementation.
- **Residual latency:** runtime resolution and Herdr’s selected-checkout operations remain on the open path. Measure those separately after removing inventory dependencies.

```markdown
# REPOS 收藏、優先更新與快速開啟

## Context

使用者常透過 `dev → 2 (REPOS) → / 搜尋 repo → Enter` 在 Herdr 開啟日常開發的 repository，但選到目標仍會遇到掃描等待。這次改善分成兩件事：**常用 repo 容易找到**，以及 **開啟已選目標不依賴無關 repo 的掃描**。只加入置頂不能完整解決問題。

程式碼已確認：
- 現有載入會先顯示 cache／候選列，但 `Pending` 同時被鍵盤與 action registry 用來阻擋開啟（`internal/tui/model.go:3174`、`action_registry.go:134`）。刷新也會把既有列標為 pending。
- REPOS enrichment 要先等完整 discovery；部分 `runtime pending` 列直到最後整批結果才更新（`internal/cli/tui_load.go:174–185, 233–271`）。
- 普通開啟回呼只用選中路徑呼叫 runtime，不需要完整 inventory，但目前缺少獨立的目標新鮮驗證（`internal/cli/tui.go:382–400`）。不能只刪除 pending guard。
- Catalog 已有穩定 ID、個人 metadata 與 host location，尚無 favorite；普通 repo 也沒有完整的最近開啟紀錄。

這些是程式碼上的等待來源，尚未實測使用者那一次的延遲；Herdr 自身的 open/focus 耗時不一定會隨此修正消失。本輪只規劃，未修改產品程式或操作使用者的 repo/runtime。

## 使用體驗與範圍

- REPOS 父層 repository 列以 **`f` 切換收藏**，顯示 `★`，動作選單也提供加入／取消收藏。
- 收藏永久保存在本機 catalog，與 tags／note 並列；一個旗標同時代表置頂及優先更新。不建立 task、不改 Git、不記錄自動使用頻率。
- 先套用搜尋及既有排序，再把收藏穩定排到前面。反向／欄位排序仍在各群組內生效，worktree children 跟隨 parent；不匹配搜尋的收藏不出現。
- 啟動及明確刷新優先顯示、更新收藏；其餘 repo 繼續背景發現及更新。
- **所有 REPOS 項目的純開啟**都可走目標專屬驗證，不必等全域掃描；不僅限收藏。
- 保留既有搜尋語意：搜尋中的第一次 Enter 結束輸入，回到列表後 Enter／`o` 開啟。不擴及 FLEET／TRY 收藏、單獨 worktree 收藏、首頁捷徑、自動排名或新 CLI 子命令。

## 實作步驟

### 1. 先拆開「導航」與「完整觀測」的 readiness

主要檔案：`internal/tui/action_registry.go`、`action_definitions.go`、`model.go`、`internal/cli/tui.go`；在 `internal/repo/` 放可獨立測試的單目標解析／驗證 helper，CLI 負責接線。

- 讓 REPOS `listActionOpen` 通過 pending 的兩層 gate，且 keyboard／menu 使用同一規則。仍檢查 callback、child missing/prunable；不清掉 `Pending`，不改 start、cleanup、batch 等既有 guard。
- 開啟請求綁定選中的 path、已知 canonical/common-dir identity，以及 child checkout identity；在 runtime 呼叫前重新檢查該目標。重用 `pathx.Canonical`、`gitx.Discover` 與既有 worktree lookup，不呼叫會 fallback 到全域 discovery 的名稱解析。
- Git repo 檢查目錄、checkout root 與已知 Git 身分是否一致；child 另確認仍屬於同一 repository 且可用。失敗留在 TUI 顯示錯誤，不默默改開其他路徑。
- 保留既有非 Git 目錄支援：明確觀測為 plain directory 的項目只需要相應目錄驗證；unknown／Git 讀取失敗不能降級成 plain directory 來放行。
- 驗證不排在背景 enrichment limiter 後，也不等待全域 task、status、runtime `List`。仍解析實際 runtime 並沿用 `openResolved` → `openCheckout` → Herdr no-focus open → 退出 TUI → activate 的流程。
- 沿用既有 canonical/common-dir 身分保證，不為收藏另建 repository 身分系統；不宣稱能僅靠路徑字串辨識同一路徑刪除重建。已可觀察的路徑／身分不一致必須拒絕。

### 2. 收藏以 catalog intent 持久化，更新只影響該列

主要檔案：`internal/catalog/catalog.go`、`registry.go` 與 tests；`internal/tui/rows.go`、action registry／list actions；CLI 增加小型 favorite adapter（可獨立為 `internal/cli/repo_favorite.go`）。

- `catalog.Entry` 增加 additive `Favorite bool`，舊資料缺欄位等於 false；不改 schema 既有欄位名稱。掃描仍是 read-only，不因顯示列表而替所有 repo 建 catalog。
- `RepoActions` 新增明確的 `SetFavorite(ctx, row, desired bool)`，回傳更新後的 asset。保留現有 tags/note `Patch` callback 不變；沿用 `Registry.Patch` 的 locked mutation closure，只改 Favorite。
- 有 catalog ID 時操作該 asset 的收藏 intent；沒有 ID 時先做選中目標的新鮮解析，再於明確收藏動作中使用 `EnsureRepository`。不得把 `patchRepositoryCatalog` 現有的容錯 Git lookup 當成新鮮驗證。
- 收藏是新 metadata action，不放寬其他既有動作。已綁定 asset 的取消收藏不應因 repo 暫時不可用而被永久卡住；未綁定候選不得未驗證就建立身分。
- 使用專用結果訊息，成功才局部更新標記／排序，不觸發 generic `actionMsg` 的全量 reload。以 asset ID 套用結果、序列化同項目的修改，錯誤不可假裝成功。
- 在兩層既有排序後 stable-partition 收藏，沿用 `currentToken`／`repoFocusPath`／`restoreRepoFocus` 保持選中目標，避免重新排序後 Enter 開錯列。

### 3. 收藏先載入、先排入更新，不只是把顯示排序改掉

主要檔案：`internal/cli/tui_load.go`、`tui.go` 的 `collectReposWithOptions`、`repo_catalog.go`；`internal/tui/repo_progress.go` 與 local-result handling。

- 每次 load generation 先讀 catalog 的收藏及目前 host location。以 `Cfg.DiscoveryRoots()` 和既有 `repo.PathDiscoverableFromRoot` 套用深度、排除目錄、symlink alias 規則；收藏不能擴張掃描範圍。
- 在 cache 不存在時也能發布收藏的 provisional rows，明示 pending／unavailable；對這些已知路徑直接執行 target-only discovery/enrichment，不等完整 `repo.Discover` 回傳。
- 全量 discovery 照常並行。抽出可重用的單 repo enrichment，使用 bounded dispatcher 明確讓收藏先取得 REPOS 工作名額，沿用現有資源上限；不能只把 slice 排序後讓所有 goroutine 搶 limiter。
- 優先指尚未執行工作的排程順序，不保證完成順序，也不搶占已執行工作。收藏失敗／慢速不能變成所有普通 repo 的額外整批 barrier；保留取消和逐列錯誤。
- 同一 generation 以已驗證的 common-dir／canonical identity 去重收藏與全量結果，避免重複列、重複 enrichment 和 alias 重複。Runtime observation 就緒時更新已完成的列，不必等所有 enrichment 完成。
- Catalog preference 與 observation snapshot 分開合併：cache、舊 generation、較晚到達的 final snapshot 不能蓋回成功的收藏操作；新 generation 也不能讓成功的 intent 修改遺失。
- 暫時 missing／掃描不完整不刪除 durable favorite；適用範圍內保留 unavailable 狀態，不能假裝 clean。離開設定掃描範圍的 asset 不列入本次 REPOS。Final snapshot 的替換邏輯須保留這些區別。
- Snapshot cache 仍是可丟棄的展示資料，不作為收藏的唯一來源，也不授權任何 destructive action。
```

```text
## Approved Plan:
# REPOS 收藏、優先更新與快速開啟

## Context

使用者常透過 `dev → 2 (REPOS) → / 搜尋 repo → Enter` 在 Herdr 開啟日常開發的 repository，但選到目標仍會遇到掃描等待。這次改善分成兩件事：**常用 repo 容易找到**，以及 **開啟已選目標不依賴無關 repo 的掃描**。只加入置頂不能完整解決問題。

程式碼已確認：
- 現有載入會先顯示 cache／候選列，但 `Pending` 同時被鍵盤與 action registry 用來阻擋開啟（`internal/tui/model.go:3174`、`action_registry.go:134`）。刷新也會把既有列標為 pending。
- REPOS enrichment 要先等完整 discovery；部分 `runtime pending` 列直到最後整批結果才更新（`internal/cli/tui_load.go:174–185, 233–271`）。
- 普通開啟回呼只用選中路徑呼叫 runtime，不需要完整 inventory，但目前缺少獨立的目標新鮮驗證（`internal/cli/tui.go:382–400`）。不能只刪除 pending guard。
- Catalog 已有穩定 ID、個人 metadata 與 host location，尚無 favorite；普通 repo 也沒有完整的最近開啟紀錄。

這些是程式碼上的等待來源，尚未實測使用者那一次的延遲；Herdr 自身的 open/focus 耗時不一定會隨此修正消失。本輪只規劃，未修改產品程式或操作使用者的 repo/runtime。

## 使用體驗與範圍

- REPOS 父層 repository 列以 **`f` 切換收藏**，顯示 `★`，動作選單也提供加入／取消收藏。
- 收藏永久保存在本機 catalog，與 tags／note 並列；一個旗標同時代表置頂及優先更新。不建立 task、不改 Git、不記錄自動使用頻率。
- 先套用搜尋及既有排序，再把收藏穩定排到前面。反向／欄位排序仍在各群組內生效，worktree children 跟隨 parent；不匹配搜尋的收藏不出現。
- 啟動及明確刷新優先顯示、更新收藏；其餘 repo 繼續背景發現及更新。
- **所有 REPOS 項目的純開啟**都可走目標專屬驗證，不必等全域掃描；不僅限收藏。
- 保留既有搜尋語意：搜尋中的第一次 Enter 結束輸入，回到列表後 Enter／`o` 開啟。不擴及 FLEET／TRY 收藏、單獨 worktree 收藏、首頁捷徑、自動排名或新 CLI 子命令。

## 實作步驟

### 1. 先拆開「導航」與「完整觀測」的 readiness

主要檔案：`internal/tui/action_registry.go`、`action_definitions.go`、`model.go`、`internal/cli/tui.go`；在 `internal/repo/` 放可獨立測試的單目標解析／驗證 helper，CLI 負責接線。

- 讓 REPOS `listActionOpen` 通過 pending 的兩層 gate，且 keyboard／menu 使用同一規則。仍檢查 callback、child missing/prunable；不清掉 `Pending`，不改 start、cleanup、batch 等既有 guard。
- 開啟請求綁定選中的 path、已知 canonical/common-dir identity，以及 child checkout identity；在 runtime 呼叫前重新檢查該目標。重用 `pathx.Canonical`、`gitx.Discover` 與既有 worktree lookup，不呼叫會 fallback 到全域 discovery 的名稱解析。
- Git repo 檢查目錄、checkout root 與已知 Git 身分是否一致；child 另確認仍屬於同一 repository 且可用。失敗留在 TUI 顯示錯誤，不默默改開其他路徑。
- 保留既有非 Git 目錄支援：明確觀測為 plain directory 的項目只需要相應目錄驗證；unknown／Git 讀取失敗不能降級成 plain directory 來放行。
- 驗證不排在背景 enrichment limiter 後，也不等待全域 task、status、runtime `List`。仍解析實際 runtime 並沿用 `openResolved` → `openCheckout` → Herdr no-focus open → 退出 TUI → activate 的流程。
- 沿用既有 canonical/common-dir 身分保證，不為收藏另建 repository 身分系統；不宣稱能僅靠路徑字串辨識同一路徑刪除重建。已可觀察的路徑／身分不一致必須拒絕。

### 2. 收藏以 catalog intent 持久化，更新只影響該列

主要檔案：`internal/catalog/catalog.go`、`registry.go` 與 tests；`internal/tui/rows.go`、action registry／list actions；CLI 增加小型 favorite adapter（可獨立為 `internal/cli/repo_favorite.go`）。

- `catalog.Entry` 增加 additive `Favorite bool`，舊資料缺欄位等於 false；不改 schema 既有欄位名稱。掃描仍是 read-only，不因顯示列表而替所有 repo 建 catalog。
- `RepoActions` 新增明確的 `SetFavorite(ctx, row, desired bool)`，回傳更新後的 asset。保留現有 tags/note `Patch` callback 不變；沿用 `Registry.Patch` 的 locked mutation closure，只改 Favorite。
- 有 catalog ID 時操作該 asset 的收藏 intent；沒有 ID 時先做選中目標的新鮮解析，再於明確收藏動作中使用 `EnsureRepository`。不得把 `patchRepositoryCatalog` 現有的容錯 Git lookup 當成新鮮驗證。
- 收藏是新 metadata action，不放寬其他既有動作。已綁定 asset 的取消收藏不應因 repo 暫時不可用而被永久卡住；未綁定候選不得未驗證就建立身分。
- 使用專用結果訊息，成功才局部更新標記／排序，不觸發 generic `actionMsg` 的全量 reload。以 asset ID 套用結果、序列化同項目的修改，錯誤不可假裝成功。
- 在兩層既有排序後 stable-partition 收藏，沿用 `currentToken`／`repoFocusPath`／`restoreRepoFocus` 保持選中目標，避免重新排序後 Enter 開錯列。

### 3. 收藏先載入、先排入更新，不只是把顯示排序改掉

主要檔案：`internal/cli/tui_load.go`、`tui.go` 的 `collectReposWithOptions`、`repo_catalog.go`；`internal/tui/repo_progress.go` 與 local-result handling。

- 每次 load generation 先讀 catalog 的收藏及目前 host location。以 `Cfg.DiscoveryRoots()` 和既有 `repo.PathDiscoverableFromRoot` 套用深度、排除目錄、symlink alias 規則；收藏不能擴張掃描範圍。
- 在 cache 不存在時也能發布收藏的 provisional rows，明示 pending／unavailable；對這些已知路徑直接執行 target-only discovery/enrichment，不等完整 `repo.Discover` 回傳。
- 全量 discovery 照常並行。抽出可重用的單 repo enrichment，使用 bounded dispatcher 明確讓收藏先取得 REPOS 工作名額，沿用現有資源上限；不能只把 slice 排序後讓所有 goroutine 搶 limiter。
- 優先指尚未執行工作的排程順序，不保證完成順序，也不搶占已執行工作。收藏失敗／慢速不能變成所有普通 repo 的額外整批 barrier；保留取消和逐列錯誤。
- 同一 generation 以已驗證的 common-dir／canonical identity 去重收藏與全量結果，避免重複列、重複 enrichment 和 alias 重複。Runtime observation 就緒時更新已完成的列，不必等所有 enrichment 完成。
- Catalog preference 與 observation snapshot 分開合併：cache、舊 generation、較晚到達的 final snapshot 不能蓋回成功的收藏操作；新 generation 也不能讓成功的 intent 修改遺失。
- 暫時 missing／掃描不完整不刪除 durable favorite；適用範圍內保留 unavailable 狀態，不能假裝 clean。離開設定掃描範圍的 asset 不列入本次 REPOS。Final snapshot 的替換邏輯須保留這些區別。
- Snapshot cache 仍是可丟棄的展示資料，不作為收藏的唯一來源，也不授權任何 destructive action。

- 更新 README、`internal/tui/help_content.go`／action guidance、相關 CLI embedded help，以及 `internal/skill/dev-cli/SKILL.md`／`references/command-navigation.md` 的受影響描述。

- 不新增 CLI syntax；若實作實際改到 Cobra help／flags，才跑 `make skill-sync`，不可手改 generated commands block。任何新增 structured field 都只做 additive 變更並測相容性。
```

```text
38	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
39	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
40		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
41		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
42		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
43			"rev-parse",
44			"--path-format=absolute",
45			"--show-toplevel",
46			"--git-dir",
47			"--git-common-dir",
48			"--is-bare-repository",
49		)
50		if err != nil {
51			return Repo{}, err
52		}
53		f := lines(out)
54		r := Repo{}
55		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
56		switch len(f) {
57		case 4:
58			r.Root = f[0]
59			r.GitDir = f[1]
60			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
61			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
62		case 3:
63			r.GitDir = f[0]
64			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
65			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
66		default:
67			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
68		}
69	
70		// Git for Windows reports forward slashes and may expand an 8.3 path.
71		// Expose one physical, native spelling at the Git boundary so callers never
72		// compare those strings with an unrelated lexical spelling of the same path.
73		for _, field := range []*string{&r.Root, &r.GitDir, &r.GitCommonDir} {
74			if *field == "" {
75				continue
76			}
77			*field, err = pathx.Canonical(*field)
78			if err != nil {
79				return Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git repository path: %w", err)
80			}
81		}
82	
83		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
84		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
85		if r.Bare {
86			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
87		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {

89			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
90			r.MainRoot = r.Root
91		} else {

96				if !filepath.IsAbs(configured) {

104				return Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot verify main checkout for Git common directory %s", r.GitCommonDir)
105			}
106			r.MainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(fields[0])
107			if err != nil {
108				return Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize main checkout: %w", err)
109			}
110		}
111		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
112		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)

118			}
119		}

123	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of

125	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
126		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
127		return err == nil

130	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
131	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
132	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
133	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
134	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
135		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
136			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
137				return b
138			}
139		}
140		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
141			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
142				return cand
143			}
144		}
145		return ""
146	}

148	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
149	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
150		if name == "" {
151			name = "origin"
152		}
153		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
154		if err != nil {
155			return ""
156		}
157		return out
158	}

160	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
161	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
162	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
163	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
164	// semantics should use Remote instead.
165	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
166		if commonDir == "" {
167			return ""
168		}
169		if name == "" {
170			name = "origin"
171		}
172		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
173		if err != nil {
174			return ""
175		}
176		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
177		section := ""
178		lines := strings.Split(string(b), "\n")
179		for index, raw := range lines {
180			line := strings.Trim(raw, " \t\r\v\f")
181			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
182				continue
183			}
184			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
185				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
186				continue
187			}
188			if section != want {
189				continue
190			}
191			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(raw, "=")
192			if ok && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(key), "url") {
193				decoded, valid := remoteConfigValue(value, lines[index+1:])
194				if valid {
195					return decoded
196				}
197				return ""
198			}
199		}
200		return ""
201	}
202	
203	// remoteConfigValue decodes Git's value grammar without evaluating Includes or
204	// URL rewriting. Git escapes backslashes even in unquoted Windows-path values;
205	// trimming quotes alone corrupts those URLs. Only Git's five escapes are valid.
206	func remoteConfigValue(value string, continuation []string) (string, bool) {
207		value = strings.TrimSuffix(value, "\r")
208		var result []byte
209		quoted, started := false, false
210		trailing := 0
211		for index := 0; index < len(value); index++ {
212			c := value[index]
213			switch {
214			case c == 0:
215				return "", false
216			case c == '\\':
217				index++
218				if index == len(value) {
219					if len(continuation) == 0 {
220						return "", false
221					}
222					value, continuation = strings.TrimSuffix(continuation[0], "\r"), continuation[1:]
223					index = -1
224					continue
225				}
226				switch value[index] {
227				case 'n':
228					c = '\n'
229				case 't':
230					c = '\t'
231				case 'b':
232					c = '\b'
233				case '\\', '"':
234					c = value[index]
235				default:
236					return "", false
237				}
238				result = append(result, c)
239				started, trailing = true, 0
240			case c == '"':
241				quoted, trailing = !quoted, 0
242			case !quoted && (c == '#' || c == ';'):
243				return string(result[:len(result)-trailing]), true
244			case !quoted && (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\v' || c == '\f'):
245				if started {
246					result = append(result, c)
247					trailing++
248				}
249			default:
250				result = append(result, c)
251				started, trailing = true, 0
252			}
253		}
254		if quoted {
255			return "", false
256		}
257		return string(result[:len(result)-trailing]), true
258	}
```

```text
141	func worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
142		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
143		if err != nil {
144			return nil, err

146		var (

148			cur  *Worktree

152				list = append(list, *cur)
153				cur = nil
154			}
155		}
156		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
157			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
158				flush()
159				continue
160			}
161			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")

171				if cur != nil {

173				}
174			case "branch":
175				if cur != nil {
176					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
177				}
178			case "detached":
179				if cur != nil {
180					cur.Detached = true
181				}
182			case "bare":
183				if cur != nil {
184					cur.Bare = true
185				}
186			case "locked":
187				if cur != nil {
188					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
189				}
190			case "prunable":
191				if cur != nil {
192					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		flush()

198		// worktree. Normalize that record using the verified physical checkout.
199		if len(list) > 0 && !list[0].Bare {
200			repository, discoverErr := Discover(ctx, dir)
201			if discoverErr != nil {
202				return nil, discoverErr
203			}
204			list[0].Path = repository.MainRoot

212	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
213		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)

229	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would

246	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
```

```text
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
```
