```text
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")

41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54	
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}

102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117	
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134	
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}

148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {

164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:

186	// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
187	// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
188	// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int
194	}

196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {

227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}

235	// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
236	// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
237	func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
238		if maxBytes < 0 {
239			return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
240		}
241		if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
242			return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
243		}
244		if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
246		}
247		if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
248			return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
249		}
250		if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {

256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil

269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}

301	func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
302		return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))

309	func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {

320		if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
```

```text
1	package tui
```

```text
9	
10	// LocalLoadRequest identifies the three view generations sharing one source
11	// snapshot. Each result remains independently replaceable.
12	type LocalLoadRequest struct {
13		CycleGeneration uint64
14		TasksGeneration uint64
15		ReposGeneration uint64
16		TriesGeneration uint64
17		ShowAllTries    bool
18		ForceSizes      bool
19	}
20	
21	// LocalResult is one terminal TASKS, REPOS, or TRY snapshot.
22	type LocalResult struct {
23		Phase      string
24		View       View
25		Generation uint64
26		Tasks      []inventory.Row
27		Repos      []RepoRow
28		Tries      []TryRow
29		Valid      bool
30		Err        error
31	}
32	
33	// LocalLoad is a cancellable stream owned by the caller's context.
34	type LocalLoad struct {
35		ID      uint64
36		Request LocalLoadRequest
37		Results <-chan LocalResult
38	}
39	
40	// LocalActions starts one shared local source cycle.
41	type LocalActions struct {
42		Start func(context.Context, LocalLoadRequest) LocalLoad
43	}
44	
45	type localMsg struct {
46		load   LocalLoad
47		result LocalResult
48		done   bool
49	}
50	
51	func (m Model) startLocalLoad() tea.Cmd {
52		if m.actions.Local.Start == nil {
53			return nil
54		}
55		request := LocalLoadRequest{
56			CycleGeneration: m.localGeneration,
57			TasksGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
58			ReposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
59			TriesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
60			ShowAllTries:    m.showAllTries,
61			ForceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
62		}
63		load := m.actions.Local.Start(m.localReadContext(), request)
64		load.Request = request
65		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return waitForLocal(load)
69	}
70	
71	func waitForLocal(load LocalLoad) tea.Cmd {
72		return func() tea.Msg {
73			result, ok := <-load.Results
74			if !ok {
75				return localMsg{load: load, done: true}
76			}
77			return localMsg{load: load, result: result}
78		}
79	}
80	
81	func (m Model) applyLocalResult(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
82		accepted := false
83		if result.View == ViewRepos && result.Phase != "" {
84			return m.applyRepoProgress(result)
85		}
86		token := m.currentToken()
87		path := m.repoFocusPath()
88		switch result.View {
89		case ViewTasks:
90			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
91				ViewTasks, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
92				len(result.Tasks), result.Err, result.Valid,
93			)
94			if accepted && result.Valid {
95				m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), result.Tasks...)
96			}
97		case ViewRepos:
98			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
99				ViewRepos, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
100				len(result.Repos), result.Err, result.Valid,
101			)
102			if accepted && result.Valid {
103				m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, "")
104				m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(result.Err)
105				if result.Err != nil {
106					m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
107				} else {
108					m.repos = completeRepoRows(m.repos, result.Repos)
109				}
110				m.repoProgressPhase = 3
111				m.matchRemoteLocals()
112			}
113		case ViewTries:
114			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
115				ViewTries, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
116				len(result.Tries), result.Err, result.Valid,
117			)
118			if accepted && result.Valid {
119				m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), result.Tries...)
120				m.matchRemoteLocals()
121			}
122		}
123		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
124		m.setAt(m.at())
125		return m, accepted
126	}
```

```text
17	func TestTUILocalLoaderSharesInputsAndPublishesViewsIndependently(t *testing.T) {
18		app := &App{trace: perftrace.New(64)}
19		loader := &tuiLocalLoader{app: app}
20		var taskReads, runtimeReads, repoReads atomic.Int32
21		taskStarted, runtimeStarted, repoStarted := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
22		tracked := []*task.Task{{ID: "task-a", Name: "task-a", Repo: "api", RepoPath: "/src/api"}}
23		discovered := []repo.Repo{{Name: "api", Path: "/src/api", RealPath: "/src/api"}}
24		loader.listTasks = func() ([]*task.Task, error) {
25			taskReads.Add(1)
26			close(taskStarted)
27			return tracked, nil
28		}
29		loader.loadRuntime = func(context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) {
30			runtimeReads.Add(1)
31			close(runtimeStarted)
32			return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil
33		}
34		loader.discoverRepos = func(context.Context) ([]repo.Repo, error) {
35			repoReads.Add(1)
36			close(repoStarted)
37			return discovered, nil
38		}
39		repoGate, tryGate := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
40		var taskLimiter, repoLimiter *inventory.Limiter
41		loader.collectTasks = func(_ context.Context, got []*task.Task, _ tuiRuntimeSnapshot,
42			limiter *inventory.Limiter) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
43			taskLimiter = limiter
44			return []inventory.Row{{Task: got[0], Checkout: got[0].RepoPath}}, nil
45		}
46		loader.collectRepos = func(_ context.Context, gotTasks []*task.Task, gotRepos []repo.Repo,
47			_ tuiRuntimeSnapshot, limiter *inventory.Limiter) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
48			<-repoGate
49			repoLimiter = limiter
50			if len(gotTasks) != 1 || len(gotRepos) != 1 {
51				t.Fatalf("shared inputs tasks=%d repos=%d", len(gotTasks), len(gotRepos))
52			}
53			return []tui.RepoRow{{Repo: gotRepos[0], Tasks: gotTasks}}, nil
54		}
55		loader.collectTries = func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
56			<-tryGate
57			return []tui.TryRow{{}}, nil
58		}
59	
60		load := loader.Start(context.Background(), tui.LocalLoadRequest{
61			TasksGeneration: 1, ReposGeneration: 2, TriesGeneration: 3,
62		})
63		first := receiveLocalResult(t, load.Results)
64		if first.View != tui.ViewTasks || first.Generation != 1 || len(first.Tasks) != 1 {
65			t.Fatalf("first result = %+v", first)
66		}
67		<-taskStarted
68		<-runtimeStarted
69		<-repoStarted
70		if taskReads.Load() != 1 || runtimeReads.Load() != 1 || repoReads.Load() != 1 {
71			t.Fatalf("input reads tasks=%d runtime=%d repos=%d", taskReads.Load(), runtimeReads.Load(), repoReads.Load())
72		}
73	
74		close(repoGate)
75		second := receiveLocalResult(t, load.Results)
76		if second.View != tui.ViewRepos || second.Generation != 2 || len(second.Repos) != 1 {
77			t.Fatalf("second result = %+v", second)
78		}
79		if taskLimiter == nil || taskLimiter != repoLimiter {
80			t.Fatal("TASKS and REPOS did not share one enrichment limiter")
81		}
82	
83		close(tryGate)
84		third := receiveLocalResult(t, load.Results)
85		if third.View != tui.ViewTries || third.Generation != 3 || len(third.Tries) != 1 {
86			t.Fatalf("third result = %+v", third)
87		}
88		if _, ok := <-load.Results; ok {
89			t.Fatal("local result stream did not close")
90		}
91	}
92	
93	func receiveLocalResult(t *testing.T, results <-chan tui.LocalResult) tui.LocalResult {
94		t.Helper()
95		select {
96		case result, ok := <-results:
97			if !ok {
98				t.Fatal("local result stream closed early")
99			}
100			return result
101		case <-time.After(time.Second):
102			t.Fatal("timed out waiting for local result")
103			return tui.LocalResult{}
104		}
105	}
```

```text
287							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
288							GitDir:    gitDir,
289							CommonDir: commonDir,
290							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
291							Bare:      bare,
292							HasGit:    true,
293						})
294					}
295					if opts.OnCandidate != nil && !gitEntryIsFile(path) {
296						category := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel))
297						if category == "." {
298							category = ""
299						}
300						opts.OnCandidate(Repo{Name: name, Path: path, RealPath: real, Root: rootClean, Category: category, HasGit: true, Bare: bare})
301					}
302					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
303					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
304					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
305					return filepath.SkipDir
306				}
307				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
308					return filepath.SkipDir
309				}
310				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
311					if !seen[path] {
312						seen[path] = true
313						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
314					}
315				}
316				return nil
317			})
318			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
319				return out, ctx.Err()
320			}
321		}
322	
323		if !opts.Fast {
324			workers := min(max(1, opts.Workers), 8)
325			jobs := make(chan int)
326			linked := make([]bool, len(out))
327			var wg sync.WaitGroup
328			for n := 0; n < workers; n++ {
329				wg.Go(func() {
330					for i := range jobs {
331						r := &out[i]
332						if !r.HasGit || r.Bare {
333							continue
334						}
335						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, r.Path); err == nil {
336							linked[i] = g.IsLinkedWorktree
337							r.GitDir, r.CommonDir, r.MainRoot, r.RealPath = g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot, g.MainRoot
338						}
339					}
340				})
341			}
342			for i := range out {
343				jobs <- i
344			}
345			close(jobs)
346			wg.Wait()
347			if ctx.Err() != nil {
348				return nil, ctx.Err()
349			}
350			accepted := make([]Repo, 0, len(out))
351			ids := map[string]bool{}
352			for i, r := range out {
353				key := r.CommonDir
354				if key == "" {
355					key = r.Path
356				}
357				if linked[i] || ids[key] {
358					continue
359				}
360				ids[key] = true
361				accepted = append(accepted, r)
362			}
363			out = accepted
364		}
365	
366		for i := range out {
367			if out[i].Category == "." {
368				out[i].Category = ""
369			}
370		}
371		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
372			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
373				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
374			}
375			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
376		})
377		return out, nil
378	}
379	
380	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
381	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
382	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
383		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
384			return true
385		}
386		return isBareDir(path)
387	}
388	
389	func gitEntryIsFile(path string) bool {
390		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git"))
391		return err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular()
392	}
393	
394	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
395	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
396		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
397			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
398				return false
399			}
400		}
401		return true
402	}
403	
404	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
405	//
406	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
407	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
408	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
409	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
410		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
411	}
412	
413	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
414	// process per repository in the scan roots.
415	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
416		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())
417	}
418	
419	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
420		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
421			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
422				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
423				if real == "" {
424					real = g.MainRoot
425				}
426				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
427				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
428				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
429				return Repo{
430					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
431					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
432				}, nil, nil
433			}
434		}
435		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
436		if err != nil {
437			return Repo{}, nil, err
438		}
439		for _, r := range all {
440			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
441				return r, nil, nil
442			}
443		}
444		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
445		var hits []Repo
446		for _, r := range all {
447			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
448				hits = append(hits, r)
449			}
450		}
451		switch len(hits) {
452		case 1:
453			return hits[0], nil, nil
454		case 0:
455			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
456		default:
457			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
458		}
459	}
460	
461	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
462	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
463	
464	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
465	
466	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
467	type AmbiguousError struct {
468		Ref        string
469		Candidates []Repo
470	}
471	
472	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
473		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
474		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
475			names[i] = c.Display()
476		}
477		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
478	}
```

```text
1	package gitx
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"sync"
6	
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
8	)
9	
10	type observationKey struct{}
11	type observation struct {
12		ready chan struct{}
13		value any
14		err   error
15	}
16	type observations struct {
17		sync.Mutex
18		slots   chan struct{}
19		entries map[string]*observation
20	}
21	
22	// WithObservations shares read-only Git probes within one inventory cycle.
23	// Never carry this context across a mutation or into another refresh.
24	func WithObservations(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
25		return context.WithValue(ctx, observationKey{}, &observations{entries: map[string]*observation{}, slots: make(chan struct{}, 8)})
26	}
27	
28	func observe[T any](ctx context.Context, kind, path string, read func() (T, error)) (T, error) {
29		cache, ok := ctx.Value(observationKey{}).(*observations)
30		if !ok {
31			return read()
32		}
33		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
34			path = canonical
35		}
36		key := kind + "\x00" + path
37		cache.Lock()
38		entry, exists := cache.entries[key]
39		if !exists {
40			entry = &observation{ready: make(chan struct{})}
41			cache.entries[key] = entry
42		}
43		cache.Unlock()
44		if exists {
45			select {
46			case <-ctx.Done():
47				var zero T
48				return zero, ctx.Err()
49			case <-entry.ready:
50			}
51			return entry.value.(T), entry.err
52		}
53		value, err := read()
54		entry.value, entry.err = value, err
55		close(entry.ready)
56		return value, err
57	}
58
```

```text
1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17	
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20	
21	type readOnlyObservationsKey struct{}
22	
23	// WithReadOnlyObservations disables Git's optional index refresh writes for
24	// this observation call tree, including nested domain helpers. Explicit Git
25	// mutations are still mutations; this is not an execution permission boundary.
26	func WithReadOnlyObservations(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
27		return context.WithValue(ctx, readOnlyObservationsKey{}, true)
28	}
29	
30	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
31	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
32	type Error struct {
33		Args   []string
34		Dir    string
35		Stderr string
36		Stdout string
37		Err    error
38	}
39	
40	func (e *Error) Error() string {
41		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
42		if msg == "" {
43			msg = e.Err.Error()
44		}
45		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
46	}
47	
48	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
49	
50	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
51	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
52		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
53	}
54	
55	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
56	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
57	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
58		if readOnly, _ := ctx.Value(readOnlyObservationsKey{}).(bool); readOnly {
59			overrides = append(append([]string{}, overrides...), "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0")
60		}
61		if observations, ok := ctx.Value(observationKey{}).(*observations); ok && observations.slots != nil {
62			select {
63			case observations.slots <- struct{}{}:
64				defer func() { <-observations.slots }()
65			case <-ctx.Done():
66				return "", ctx.Err()
67			}
68		}
69	
70		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
71		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
72		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
73		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
74		cmd.Dir = dir
75		if len(overrides) > 0 {
76			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
77			for _, override := range overrides {
78				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
79				keys[key] = true
80			}
81			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
82			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
83				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
84				if !keys[key] {
85					env = append(env, entry)
86				}
87			}
88			env = append(env, overrides...)
89			cmd.Env = env
90		}
91		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
92		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
93		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
94		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
95			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Stdout: stdout.String(), Err: err}
96			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
97				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
98			}
99			return "", gerr
100		}
101		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
102	}
103	
104	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
105	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
106	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
107		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
108	}
109	
110	// RunReadOnly disables optional index refresh writes during observations.
111	func RunReadOnly(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
112		return runEnv(ctx, dir, []string{"GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0"}, args...)
113	}
114	
115	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
116	func lines(s string) []string {
117		if s == "" {
118			return nil
119		}
120		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
121		filtered := out[:0]
122		for _, l := range out {
123			if l != "" {
124				filtered = append(filtered, l)
125			}
126		}
127		return filtered
128	}
129	
130	// nulLines splits NUL-delimited git output (-z forms).
131	func nulLines(s string) []string {
132		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
133		if s == "" {
134			return nil
135		}
136		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")
137	}
```

```text
16	// CachedRow holds presentation only: no task, runtime or action authority.
17	type CachedRow struct {
18		Repo         Repo
19		Status       gitx.Status
20		GitKnown     bool
21		LastActivity time.Time
22		Try          bool
23	}
24	type Snapshot struct {
25		Version     int
26		Fingerprint [32]byte
27		ObservedAt  time.Time
28		Rows        []CachedRow
29	}
30	
31	func SnapshotKey(roots []string, state string) [32]byte {
32		data, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
33			Roots []string
34			State string
35		}{roots, state})
36		return sha256.Sum256(data)
37	}
38	func ReadSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, key [32]byte) (Snapshot, error) {
39		data, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, path, 8<<20)
40		if err != nil {
41			return Snapshot{}, err
42		}
43		var snapshot Snapshot
44		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
45			return Snapshot{}, err
46		}
47		if snapshot.Version != 1 || snapshot.Fingerprint != key || snapshot.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
48			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("repository cache does not match this discovery configuration")
49		}
50		for _, r := range snapshot.Rows {
51			if !filepath.IsAbs(r.Repo.Path) || r.Repo.Name == "" {
52				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("invalid cached repository")
53			}
54		}
55		return snapshot, nil
56	}
57	func WriteSnapshot(path string, snapshot Snapshot) error {
58		snapshot.Version = 1
59		data, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
60		if err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		if len(data) > 8<<20 {
64			return errors.New("repository cache exceeds 8 MiB")
65		}
66		if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
67			return err
68		}
69		file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".repos-*")
70		if err != nil {
71			return err
72		}
73		defer os.Remove(file.Name())
74		if _, err = file.Write(data); err != nil {
75			file.Close()
76			return err
77		}
78		if err = file.Close(); err != nil {
79			return err
80		}
81		return os.Rename(file.Name(), path)
82	}
```

```text
1	// Package gittest builds throwaway git repositories for tests. It is a test
2	// helper that lives in a normal package so every package's tests can share it.
3	package gittest
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"os"
8		"os/exec"
9		"path/filepath"
10		"strings"
11		"testing"
12	)
13	
14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {
16		T    *testing.T
17		Root string
18	}
19	
20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49	
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.
51	func (r *Repo) Git(args ...string) string {
52		r.T.Helper()
53		return r.GitIn(r.Root, args...)
54	}
55	
56	// GitIn runs a git command in an arbitrary directory (e.g. a linked worktree).
57	func (r *Repo) GitIn(dir string, args ...string) string {
58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,
64			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
65			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
68		if err != nil {
69			r.T.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), dir, err, out)
70		}
71		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
72	}
73	
74	// Write creates or replaces a file relative to the repo root.
75	func (r *Repo) Write(rel, content string) string {
76		r.T.Helper()
77		p := filepath.Join(r.Root, rel)
78		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
79			r.T.Fatal(err)
80		}
81		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
82			r.T.Fatal(err)
83		}
84		return p
85	}
86	
87	// Commit writes a file and commits it.
88	func (r *Repo) Commit(rel, content, message string) {
89		r.T.Helper()
90		r.Write(rel, content)
91		r.Git("add", rel)
92		r.Git("commit", "-m", message)
93	}
94	
95	// Branch creates and checks out a new branch from the current HEAD.
96	func (r *Repo) Branch(name string) {
97		r.T.Helper()
98		r.Git("switch", "-c", name)
99	}
100	
101	// WithRemote turns a second bare repository into "origin" and pushes main,
102	// so tests can exercise ahead/behind and published-branch logic.
103	func (r *Repo) WithRemote() string {
104		r.T.Helper()
105		remote := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "origin.git")
106		r.GitIn(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "init", "--bare", "--initial-branch=main", remote)
107		r.Git("remote", "add", "origin", remote)
108		r.Git("push", "-u", "origin", "main")
109		return remote
110	}
111	
112	// Ctx is a convenience background context for gitx calls in tests.
113	func Ctx() context.Context { return context.Background() }
114
```

```text
1	# REPOS 收藏、優先更新與快速開啟
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	使用者常透過 `dev → 2 (REPOS) → / 搜尋 repo → Enter` 在 Herdr 開啟日常開發的 repository，但選到目標仍會遇到掃描等待。這次改善分成兩件事：**常用 repo 容易找到**，以及 **開啟已選目標不依賴無關 repo 的掃描**。只加入置頂不能完整解決問題。
6	
7	程式碼已確認：
8	- 現有載入會先顯示 cache／候選列，但 `Pending` 同時被鍵盤與 action registry 用來阻擋開啟（`internal/tui/model.go:3174`、`action_registry.go:134`）。刷新也會把既有列標為 pending。
9	- REPOS enrichment 要先等完整 discovery；部分 `runtime pending` 列直到最後整批結果才更新（`internal/cli/tui_load.go:174–185, 233–271`）。
10	- 普通開啟回呼只用選中路徑呼叫 runtime，不需要完整 inventory，但目前缺少獨立的目標新鮮驗證（`internal/cli/tui.go:382–400`）。不能只刪除 pending guard。
11	- Catalog 已有穩定 ID、個人 metadata 與 host location，尚無 favorite；普通 repo 也沒有完整的最近開啟紀錄。
12	
13	這些是程式碼上的等待來源，尚未實測使用者那一次的延遲；Herdr 自身的 open/focus 耗時不一定會隨此修正消失。本輪只規劃，未修改產品程式或操作使用者的 repo/runtime。
14	
15	## 使用體驗與範圍
16	
17	- REPOS 父層 repository 列以 **`f` 切換收藏**，顯示 `★`，動作選單也提供加入／取消收藏。
18	- 收藏永久保存在本機 catalog，與 tags／note 並列；一個旗標同時代表置頂及優先更新。不建立 task、不改 Git、不記錄自動使用頻率。
19	- 先套用搜尋及既有排序，再把收藏穩定排到前面。反向／欄位排序仍在各群組內生效，worktree children 跟隨 parent；不匹配搜尋的收藏不出現。
20	- 啟動及明確刷新優先顯示、更新收藏；其餘 repo 繼續背景發現及更新。
21	- **所有 REPOS 項目的純開啟**都可走目標專屬驗證，不必等全域掃描；不僅限收藏。
22	- 保留既有搜尋語意：搜尋中的第一次 Enter 結束輸入，回到列表後 Enter／`o` 開啟。不擴及 FLEET／TRY 收藏、單獨 worktree 收藏、首頁捷徑、自動排名或新 CLI 子命令。
23	
24	## 實作步驟
25	
26	### 1. 先拆開「導航」與「完整觀測」的 readiness
27	
28	主要檔案：`internal/tui/action_registry.go`、`action_definitions.go`、`model.go`、`internal/cli/tui.go`；在 `internal/repo/` 放可獨立測試的單目標解析／驗證 helper，CLI 負責接線。
29	
30	- 讓 REPOS `listActionOpen` 通過 pending 的兩層 gate，且 keyboard／menu 使用同一規則。仍檢查 callback、child missing/prunable；不清掉 `Pending`，不改 start、cleanup、batch 等既有 guard。
31	- 開啟請求綁定選中的 path、已知 canonical/common-dir identity，以及 child checkout identity；在 runtime 呼叫前重新檢查該目標。重用 `pathx.Canonical`、`gitx.Discover` 與既有 worktree lookup，不呼叫會 fallback 到全域 discovery 的名稱解析。
32	- Git repo 檢查目錄、checkout root 與已知 Git 身分是否一致；child 另確認仍屬於同一 repository 且可用。失敗留在 TUI 顯示錯誤，不默默改開其他路徑。
33	- 保留既有非 Git 目錄支援：明確觀測為 plain directory 的項目只需要相應目錄驗證；unknown／Git 讀取失敗不能降級成 plain directory 來放行。
34	- 驗證不排在背景 enrichment limiter 後，也不等待全域 task、status、runtime `List`。仍解析實際 runtime 並沿用 `openResolved` → `openCheckout` → Herdr no-focus open → 退出 TUI → activate 的流程。
35	- 沿用既有 canonical/common-dir 身分保證，不為收藏另建 repository 身分系統；不宣稱能僅靠路徑字串辨識同一路徑刪除重建。已可觀察的路徑／身分不一致必須拒絕。
36	
37	### 2. 收藏以 catalog intent 持久化，更新只影響該列
38	
39	主要檔案：`internal/catalog/catalog.go`、`registry.go` 與 tests；`internal/tui/rows.go`、action registry／list actions；CLI 增加小型 favorite adapter（可獨立為 `internal/cli/repo_favorite.go`）。
40	
41	- `catalog.Entry` 增加 additive `Favorite bool`，舊資料缺欄位等於 false；不改 schema 既有欄位名稱。掃描仍是 read-only，不因顯示列表而替所有 repo 建 catalog。
42	- `RepoActions` 新增明確的 `SetFavorite(ctx, row, desired bool)`，回傳更新後的 asset。保留現有 tags/note `Patch` callback 不變；沿用 `Registry.Patch` 的 locked mutation closure，只改 Favorite。
43	- 有 catalog ID 時操作該 asset 的收藏 intent；沒有 ID 時先做選中目標的新鮮解析，再於明確收藏動作中使用 `EnsureRepository`。不得把 `patchRepositoryCatalog` 現有的容錯 Git lookup 當成新鮮驗證。
44	- 收藏是新 metadata action，不放寬其他既有動作。已綁定 asset 的取消收藏不應因 repo 暫時不可用而被永久卡住；未綁定候選不得未驗證就建立身分。
45	- 使用專用結果訊息，成功才局部更新標記／排序，不觸發 generic `actionMsg` 的全量 reload。以 asset ID 套用結果、序列化同項目的修改，錯誤不可假裝成功。
46	- 在兩層既有排序後 stable-partition 收藏，沿用 `currentToken`／`repoFocusPath`／`restoreRepoFocus` 保持選中目標，避免重新排序後 Enter 開錯列。
47	
48	### 3. 收藏先載入、先排入更新，不只是把顯示排序改掉
49	
50	主要檔案：`internal/cli/tui_load.go`、`tui.go` 的 `collectReposWithOptions`、`repo_catalog.go`；`internal/tui/repo_progress.go` 與 local-result handling。
51	
52	- 每次 load generation 先讀 catalog 的收藏及目前 host location。以 `Cfg.DiscoveryRoots()` 和既有 `repo.PathDiscoverableFromRoot` 套用深度、排除目錄、symlink alias 規則；收藏不能擴張掃描範圍。
53	- 在 cache 不存在時也能發布收藏的 provisional rows，明示 pending／unavailable；對這些已知路徑直接執行 target-only discovery/enrichment，不等完整 `repo.Discover` 回傳。
54	- 全量 discovery 照常並行。抽出可重用的單 repo enrichment，使用 bounded dispatcher 明確讓收藏先取得 REPOS 工作名額，沿用現有資源上限；不能只把 slice 排序後讓所有 goroutine 搶 limiter。
55	- 優先指尚未執行工作的排程順序，不保證完成順序，也不搶占已執行工作。收藏失敗／慢速不能變成所有普通 repo 的額外整批 barrier；保留取消和逐列錯誤。
56	- 同一 generation 以已驗證的 common-dir／canonical identity 去重收藏與全量結果，避免重複列、重複 enrichment 和 alias 重複。Runtime observation 就緒時更新已完成的列，不必等所有 enrichment 完成。
57	- Catalog preference 與 observation snapshot 分開合併：cache、舊 generation、較晚到達的 final snapshot 不能蓋回成功的收藏操作；新 generation 也不能讓成功的 intent 修改遺失。
58	- 暫時 missing／掃描不完整不刪除 durable favorite；適用範圍內保留 unavailable 狀態，不能假裝 clean。離開設定掃描範圍的 asset 不列入本次 REPOS。Final snapshot 的替換邏輯須保留這些區別。
59	- Snapshot cache 仍是可丟棄的展示資料，不作為收藏的唯一來源，也不授權任何 destructive action。
60	
61	### 4. 同步使用說明
62	
63	- `CHANGELOG.md` 的 `[Unreleased]` 加入收藏與 pending-row navigation 改善。
64	- 更新 README、`internal/tui/help_content.go`／action guidance、相關 CLI embedded help，以及 `internal/skill/dev-cli/SKILL.md`／`references/command-navigation.md` 的受影響描述。
65	- 同步 `docs/guides/tui-repos-bootstrap.md` 與 `.zh-TW.md`，及其他描述 pending action authority 的 paired TUI／compatibility 頁面：明確區分「目標驗證後導航」與「仍需完整觀測的操作」。
66	- 不新增 CLI syntax；若實作實際改到 Cobra help／flags，才跑 `make skill-sync`，不可手改 generated commands block。任何新增 structured field 都只做 additive 變更並測相容性。
```

```text
29	func startTUIFuture[T any](work func() (T, error)) *tuiFuture[T] {

34		}()

36	}

43		case <-f.ready:
44			return f.value, f.err
45		}
46	}

295	func joinRuntime(row *tui.RepoRow, live tuiRuntimeSnapshot) {

302		row.RuntimeHandle = ""
303		row.RuntimeStatus = ""
304		row.Runtime = name
```

```text
93	func receiveLocalResult(t *testing.T, results <-chan tui.LocalResult) tui.LocalResult {
94		t.Helper()
95		select {
96		case result, ok := <-results:
97			if !ok {
98				t.Fatal("local result stream closed early")
99			}
100			return result
101		case <-time.After(time.Second):
102			t.Fatal("timed out waiting for local result")
103			return tui.LocalResult{}
104		}
105	}
```

```text
1031	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.

1046	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
1047	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
1048	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
1049		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
1050	}

1052	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
1053		repos := options.Repos
1054		var err error
1055		if !options.ReposSet {
1056			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1057			if err != nil {
1058				return nil, err
1059			}
1060		}
1061		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
1062		if err != nil {
1063			return nil, err
1064		}
1065		if !options.IncludeTries {
1066			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
1067			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
1068			for index, repository := range repos {
1069				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
1070					continue
1071				}
1072				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
1073				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
1074			}
1075			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
1076		}
1077		tasks := options.Tasks
1078		var taskDiagnostics []task.Diagnostic
1079		if !options.TasksSet {
1080			tasks, taskDiagnostics, err = app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
1081			if err != nil {
1082				return nil, err
1083			}
1084		}
1085		var taskInventoryErr error
1086		for _, diagnostic := range taskDiagnostics {
1087			taskInventoryErr = errors.Join(taskInventoryErr, diagnostic)
1088		}
1089		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
1090		for _, tracked := range tasks {
1091			byRepo[tracked.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[tracked.RepoPath], tracked)
1092		}
1093		sessions := options.Sessions
1094		runtimeErr := options.SessionsErr
1095		if !options.SessionsSet {
1096			sessions, runtimeErr = rt.List(ctx)
1097		}
1098		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
1099		if app.Notes != nil {
1100			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
1101			if noteErr != nil {
1102				return nil, noteErr
1103			}
1104			for _, n := range allNotes {

1106			}

1109		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
1110		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising

1115		if limiter == nil {

1117		}

1120			wg.Add(1)

1122				defer wg.Done()

1126				}
1127				defer release()

1183	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1184	//
1185	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1186	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1187	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1188	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1189		var out []tui.Tool
1190		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1191			run := t.Run
1192			name := t.Name
1193			if name == "" {
1194				name = firstWord(run)
1195			}
1196			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1197			if t.Interactive {
1198				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1199				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1200				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1201				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1202				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1203			}
1204			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1205				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1206				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1207			})
1208		}
1209		return out
```

```text
12	// joinRepoAssets matches a discovery snapshot without persisting every repo.
13	// complete is false when unreadable catalog records could make a negative or
14	// duplicate match unsafe to act on.
15	func joinRepoAssets(app *App, repos []repo.Repo) (assets []*catalog.Entry, complete bool, err error) {
16		assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(repos))
17		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil {
18			return assets, true, nil
19		}
20		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
21		if err != nil {
22			app.warnf("could not read catalog metadata: %v; leaving repository rows unsuppressed", err)
23			return assets, false, nil
24		}
25		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
26			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
27		}
28		complete = len(diagnostics) == 0
29		host := configHostname()
30		for index, repository := range repos {
31			var matches []*catalog.Entry
32			for _, entry := range entries {
33				location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
34				if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
35					continue
36				}
37				if repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
38					matches = append(matches, entry)
39				}
40			}
41			catalog.Sort(matches)
42			switch len(matches) {
43			case 1:
44				assets[index] = matches[0].Clone()
45			case 0:
46			default:
47				ids := make([]string, len(matches))
48				for i, entry := range matches {
49					ids[i] = entry.ID
50				}
51				sort.Strings(ids)
52				app.warnf("repository %s matches multiple catalog assets (%v); leaving it unsuppressed", repository.Path, ids)
53			}
54		}
55		return assets, complete, nil
56	}
57	
58	func repoLocationMatches(repository repo.Repo, location catalog.Location) bool {
59		repositoryPaths := canonicalRepoValues(repository.Path, repository.RealPath)
60		locationPaths := canonicalRepoValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath)
61		for value := range repositoryPaths {
62			if _, ok := locationPaths[value]; ok {
63				return true
64			}
65		}
66		common := canonicalRepoValue(repository.CommonDir)
67		return common != "" && common == canonicalRepoValue(location.GitCommonDir)
68	}
69	
70	func canonicalRepoValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
71		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
72		for _, value := range values {
73			if canonical := canonicalRepoValue(value); canonical != "" {
74				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
75			}
76		}
77		return out
78	}
79	
80	func canonicalRepoValue(value string) string {
81		if value == "" {
82			return ""
83		}
84		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
85		if err != nil {
86			return ""
87		}
88		return canonical
89	}
90	
91	func suppressTryRepo(entry *catalog.Entry, catalogComplete bool) bool {
92		if entry == nil || !catalogComplete || entry.Kind != catalog.KindTry || entry.Experiment == nil {
93			return false
94		}
95		return entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || entry.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated
96	}
97	
98	func configHostname() string {
99		// Kept behind a function to make every matching call visibly host-scoped.
100		return config.Hostname()
101	}
102
```

```text
23		Name string

36		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
37		// projects consistently.
38		Category string

60	// Options tunes discovery.

73		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
74		MaxDepth int
75		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
76		IncludeNonRepos bool
77		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
78		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
79		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
80		Fast bool
81	}
82	
83	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
84	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
85	
86	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
87	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
88	
89	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
90	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
91	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
92		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
93		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
94		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
95		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
96	}
97	
98	// PathDiscoverableFromRoot reports whether the normal discovery walk can reach
99	// a repository at candidate from root. It mirrors the walk's depth and skipped
100	// directory policy without requiring the not-yet-created repository to exist.
101	func PathDiscoverableFromRoot(root, candidate string, opts Options) (bool, error) {
102		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
103			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
104		}
105		canonicalRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(root)
106		if err != nil {
107			return false, err
108		}
109		canonicalCandidate, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate)
110		if err != nil {
111			return false, err
112		}
113		absoluteRoot, err := filepath.Abs(root)
114		if err != nil {
115			return false, err
116		}
117		if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(absoluteRoot); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && canonicalCandidate != canonicalRoot {
118			// WalkDir can inspect a symlinked root itself, but it never follows that
119			// symlink into child repositories.
120			return false, nil
121		}
122		if alias, err := discoverableSymlinkAlias(absoluteRoot, canonicalCandidate, opts); err != nil || alias {
123			return alias, err
124		}
125		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
126		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
127			return false, nil
128		}
129		if rel == "." {
130			return true, nil
131		}
132		components := strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator))
133		if len(components) > opts.MaxDepth {
134			return false, nil
135		}
136		for _, component := range components {
137			if skipDirs[component] || (strings.HasPrefix(component, ".") && component != ".bare") {
138				return false, nil
139			}
140		}
141		return true, nil
142	}
143	
144	func canonicalSymlinkTarget(path string) (string, error) {
145		target, err := os.Readlink(path)
146		if err != nil {
147			return "", err
148		}
149		if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
150			target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(path), target)
151		}
152		return pathx.Canonical(filepath.Clean(target))
153	}
154	
155	func discoverableSymlinkAlias(root, canonicalCandidate string, opts Options) (bool, error) {
156		if _, err := os.Lstat(root); err != nil {
157			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
158				return false, nil
159			}
160			return false, err
161		}
162		found := false
163		err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
164			if walkErr != nil {
165				return nil
166			}
167			isRoot := path == root
168			rel := "."
169			depth := 0
170			if !isRoot {
171				rel, _ = filepath.Rel(root, path)
172				depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
173			}
174			name := entry.Name()
175			if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
176				if entry.IsDir() {
177					return filepath.SkipDir
178				}
179				return nil
180			}
181			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
182				if depth <= opts.MaxDepth {
183					if target, err := canonicalSymlinkTarget(path); err == nil && target == canonicalCandidate {
184						found = true
185						return fs.SkipAll
186					}
187				}
188				return nil
189			}
190			if entry.IsDir() && isRepoDir(path) {
191				return filepath.SkipDir
192			}
193			if entry.IsDir() && depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
194				return filepath.SkipDir
195			}
196			return nil
197		})
198		if err == fs.SkipAll {
199			return found, nil
200		}
201		return found, err
202	}
203	
204	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
205	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
206	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
207	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
208		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
209			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
210		}
211		seen := map[string]bool{}
212		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
213		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
214		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
215		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
216		identities := map[string]bool{}
217		var out []Repo
218	
219		for _, root := range roots {
220			info, err := os.Stat(root)
221			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
222				if opts.OnError != nil && err != nil {
223					opts.OnError(root, err)
224				}
225				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
226			}
227			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
228	
229			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
230				if err != nil {
231					if opts.OnError != nil {
232						opts.OnError(path, err)
233					}
234					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
235				}
236				if ctx.Err() != nil {
237					return ctx.Err()
238				}
239				isRoot := path == rootClean
240				name := d.Name()
241				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
242				isDir := d.IsDir()
243				if isLink {
244					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
245					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
246					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
247					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
248						isDir = info.IsDir()
249					}
250				}
251				if !isDir {
252					return nil
253				}
254				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
255					return filepath.SkipDir
256				}
257	
258				rel := "."
259				depth := 0
260				if !isRoot {
261					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
262					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
263				}
264	
265				if isRepoDir(path) {
266					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
267					if real == "" {
268						real = path
269					}
270					bare := isBareDir(path)
271					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
272					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
273						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
274						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
275						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
276						return filepath.SkipDir
277					}
278	
279					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
280						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
281						out = append(out, Repo{
282							Name:      name,
283							Path:      path,
284							RealPath:  real,
285							Symlink:   isLink,
286							Root:      rootClean,
287							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
288							GitDir:    gitDir,
289							CommonDir: commonDir,
290							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
291							Bare:      bare,
292							HasGit:    true,
293						})
294					}
295					if opts.OnCandidate != nil && !gitEntryIsFile(path) {
296						category := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel))
297						if category == "." {
298							category = ""
299						}
300						opts.OnCandidate(Repo{Name: name, Path: path, RealPath: real, Root: rootClean, Category: category, HasGit: true, Bare: bare})
301					}
302					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
303					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
304					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
305					return filepath.SkipDir
306				}
307				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
308					return filepath.SkipDir
309				}
310				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
311					if !seen[path] {
312						seen[path] = true
313						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
314					}
315				}
316				return nil
317			})
318			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
319				return out, ctx.Err()
320			}
321		}
322	
323		if !opts.Fast {
324			workers := min(max(1, opts.Workers), 8)
325			jobs := make(chan int)
326			linked := make([]bool, len(out))
327			var wg sync.WaitGroup
328			for n := 0; n < workers; n++ {
329				wg.Go(func() {
330					for i := range jobs {
331						r := &out[i]
332						if !r.HasGit || r.Bare {
333							continue
334						}
335						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, r.Path); err == nil {
336							linked[i] = g.IsLinkedWorktree
337							r.GitDir, r.CommonDir, r.MainRoot, r.RealPath = g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot, g.MainRoot
338						}
339					}
340				})
```

```text
218	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add

221		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))

226			}
```

```text
5	// Limiter bounds expensive local enrichment across collectors that would
6	// otherwise each create their own worker pool.
7	type Limiter struct {
8		permits chan struct{}
9	}
10	
11	// NewLimiter returns a context-aware concurrency bound.
12	func NewLimiter(limit int) *Limiter {
13		if limit <= 0 {
14			limit = 8
15		}
16		return &Limiter{permits: make(chan struct{}, limit)}
17	}
18	
19	// Acquire waits for one permit and returns a matching release function.
20	func (l *Limiter) Acquire(ctx context.Context) (func(), bool) {
21		if l == nil {
22			return func() {}, true
23		}
24		if ctx == nil {
25			ctx = context.Background()
26		}
27		select {
28		case l.permits <- struct{}{}:
29			return func() { <-l.permits }, true
30		case <-ctx.Done():
31			return nil, false
32		}
33	}
```

```go
package repo

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
)

// ValidateNavigation checks a repository row against current local filesystem and
// Git observations. An empty checkoutPath selects expected.Path; otherwise it
// selects an exact registered checkout of that repository. The returned path is
// the original navigation spelling, including any bootstrap symlink alias.
//
// Only identity fields present in expected can be compared. These path-based
// observations are not durable identity witnesses and cannot detect a repository
// deleted and recreated with identical paths. Validation neither mutates state
// nor guarantees that the target remains unchanged after this call returns.
func ValidateNavigation(ctx context.Context, expected Repo, checkoutPath string) (string, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	// Never let an inventory cycle's cached worktree list authorize navigation.
	ctx = gitx.WithReadOnlyObservations(gitx.WithObservations(ctx))
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	parent, err := navigationDirectory(expected.Path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := navigationIdentity("repository target", parent, expected.RealPath); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	gitKnown := expected.HasGit || expected.CommonDir != "" || expected.GitDir != "" || expected.MainRoot != "" || expected.Bare
	if !gitKnown && checkoutPath == "" {
		// An explicitly observed plain directory remains a valid navigation
		// target, even when Git would discover a repository in an ancestor.
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return expected.Path, nil
	}

	repository, err := discoverNavigationRepository(ctx, parent)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("validate repository %q: %w", expected.Path, err)
	}
	for _, identity := range []struct{ label, actual, expected string }{
		{"Git common directory", repository.GitCommonDir, expected.CommonDir},
		{"Git directory", repository.GitDir, expected.GitDir},
		{"main checkout", repository.MainRoot, expected.MainRoot},
	} {
		if err := navigationIdentity(identity.label, identity.actual, identity.expected); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	if expected.Bare && !repository.Bare {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer bare", expected.Path)
	}
	if checkoutPath == "" {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return expected.Path, nil
	}

	checkout, err := navigationDirectory(checkoutPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, parent, checkout)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", ctx.Err()
		}
		return "", fmt.Errorf("validate checkout %q: %w", checkoutPath, err)
	}
	if registered.Worktree.Prunable || registered.Worktree.Bare {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("checkout %q is prunable or bare", checkoutPath)
	}
	if err := navigationIdentity("registered Git common directory", registered.GitCommonDir, repository.GitCommonDir); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := navigationIdentity("registered main checkout", registered.RepositoryPath, repository.MainRoot); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	selected, err := discoverNavigationRepository(ctx, checkout)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("validate checkout %q: %w", checkoutPath, err)
	}
	if err := navigationIdentity("checkout Git common directory", selected.GitCommonDir, repository.GitCommonDir); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := navigationIdentity("checkout main root", selected.MainRoot, repository.MainRoot); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return checkoutPath, nil
}

func navigationDirectory(path string) (string, error) {
	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect navigation directory %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("navigation target %q is not a directory", path)
	}
	canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize navigation directory %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	return canonical, nil
}

// navigationIdentity compares known paths, including native case/path aliases.
// SameFile compares current paths, not an earlier directory identity snapshot.
func navigationIdentity(label, actual, expected string) error {
	if expected == "" {
		return nil
	}
	canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(expected)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize expected %s: %w", label, err)
	}
	if actual == canonical {
		return nil
	}
	actualInfo, actualErr := os.Stat(actual)
	expectedInfo, expectedErr := os.Stat(canonical)
	if actualErr == nil && expectedErr == nil && os.SameFile(actualInfo, expectedInfo) {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s changed: expected %q, found %q", label, canonical, actual)
}

func discoverNavigationRepository(ctx context.Context, path string) (gitx.Repo, error) {
	repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return gitx.Repo{}, ctx.Err()
	}
	if err != nil && isBareDir(path) {
		// Discover requests --show-toplevel, which Git rejects for a bare hub.
		// Verify its identity with Git rather than accepting the skeleton alone.
		out, probeErr := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, path, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-dir", "--git-common-dir", "--is-bare-repository")
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return gitx.Repo{}, ctx.Err()
		}
		if probeErr != nil {
			return gitx.Repo{}, probeErr
		}
		fields := strings.Split(out, "\n")
		if len(fields) != 3 || fields[2] != "true" {
			return gitx.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot verify bare repository %q", path)
		}
		gitDir, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(fields[0])
		if canonicalErr != nil {
			return gitx.Repo{}, canonicalErr
		}
		commonDir, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(fields[1])
		if canonicalErr != nil {
			return gitx.Repo{}, canonicalErr
		}
		repository = gitx.Repo{GitDir: gitDir, GitCommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: commonDir, Bare: true, Name: filepath.Base(path)}
		err = nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return gitx.Repo{}, err
	}
	root := repository.Root
	if repository.Bare {
		root = repository.GitCommonDir
	}
	// Discover also succeeds inside a checkout; navigation must validate the
	// selected directory itself, not silently accept an enclosing repository.
	if err := navigationIdentity("Git root", root, path); err != nil {
		return gitx.Repo{}, err
	}
	return repository, nil
}
```

```go
package tui

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
)

type repoFavoriteOverride struct {
	repository repo.Repo
	asset      *catalog.Entry
}

type repoFavoriteMsg struct {
	row   RepoRow
	asset *catalog.Entry
	err   error
}

func (m Model) toggleRepoFavorite() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	row, ok := m.currentRepo()
	if !ok || m.actions.Repos.SetFavorite == nil || m.repoFavoriteBusy {
		return m, nil
	}
	m.repoFavoriteBusy = true
	m.err, m.status = nil, "Saving repository favorite…"
	return m, func() tea.Msg {
		asset, err := m.actions.Repos.SetFavorite(context.Background(), row, !row.Favorite())
		return repoFavoriteMsg{row: row, asset: asset, err: err}
	}
}

func (m Model) applyRepoFavorite(msg repoFavoriteMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	m.repoFavoriteBusy = false
	if msg.err != nil {
		m.err, m.status = msg.err, ""
		return m, nil
	}
	if msg.asset == nil || msg.asset.ID == "" || (msg.row.Asset != nil && msg.row.Asset.ID != "" && msg.row.Asset.ID != msg.asset.ID) {
		m.err, m.status = fmt.Errorf("repository favorite returned a different catalog identity"), ""
		return m, nil
	}
	token, path := m.currentToken(), m.repoFocusPath()
	if m.repoFavorites == nil {
		m.repoFavorites = make(map[string]repoFavoriteOverride)
	}
	m.repoFavorites[msg.asset.ID] = repoFavoriteOverride{repository: msg.row.Repo, asset: msg.asset.Clone()}
	m.err, m.status = nil, "Removed favorite: "+msg.asset.Title()
	if msg.asset.Favorite {
		m.status = "Added favorite: " + msg.asset.Title()
	}
	m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
	return m, nil
}

// A successful intent write survives older cache/enrichment messages and scan
// generations. A newer catalog revision remains authoritative for all metadata.
func (m Model) withRepoFavorite(row RepoRow) RepoRow {
	for id, saved := range m.repoFavorites {
		if row.Asset != nil && row.Asset.ID != "" {
			if row.Asset.ID != id {
				continue
			}
			if row.Asset.Updated.After(saved.asset.Updated) {
				return row
			}
			row.Asset = row.Asset.Clone()
			row.Asset.Favorite = saved.asset.Favorite
			return row
		}
		if !sameFavoriteRepository(row.Repo, saved.repository) {
			continue
		}
		row.Asset = saved.asset.Clone()
		return row
	}
	return row
}

func sameFavoriteRepository(a, b repo.Repo) bool {
	if a.CommonDir != "" && b.CommonDir != "" {
		return a.CommonDir == b.CommonDir
	}
	if a.RealPath != "" && b.RealPath != "" && a.RealPath != b.RealPath {
		return false
	}
	return a.Path != "" && a.Path == b.Path
}

func favoriteRepoLabel(row RepoRow) string {
	label := row.Repo.Display()
	if row.Favorite() {
		label = "★ " + label
	}
	if row.Unavailable != "" {
		label += " (unavailable)"
	}
	return label
}
```

```go
package repo_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx/gittest"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
)

func TestValidateNavigationParent(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
	for name, observation := range map[string]repo.Repo{
		"complete":    expected,
		"candidate":   {Path: r.Root, RealPath: expected.RealPath, HasGit: true},
		"Git only":    {Path: r.Root, HasGit: true},
		"common only": {Path: r.Root, CommonDir: expected.CommonDir},
		"gitdir only": {Path: r.Root, GitDir: expected.GitDir},
		"main only":   {Path: r.Root, MainRoot: expected.MainRoot},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), observation, "", r.Root, "")
		})
	}

	for _, field := range []string{"target", "common", "gitdir", "main"} {
		t.Run("changed "+field, func(t *testing.T) {
			changed := expected
			other := t.TempDir()
			switch field {
			case "target":
				changed.RealPath = other
			case "common":
				changed.CommonDir = other
			case "gitdir":
				changed.GitDir = other
			case "main":
				changed.MainRoot = other
			}
			assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), changed, "", "", "changed")
		})
	}

	nested := filepath.Join(r.Root, "source")
	if err := os.Mkdir(nested, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: nested, HasGit: true}, "", "", "Git root changed")
}

func TestValidateNavigationSymlink(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
	alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bootstrap-alias")
	navigationSymlink(t, r.Root, alias)
	expected.Path, expected.Symlink = alias, true
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, "", alias, "")

	if err := os.Remove(alias); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	navigationSymlink(t, t.TempDir(), alias)
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, "", "", "repository target changed")
}

func TestValidateNavigationRequiresExistingDirectory(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"missing", "file", "empty path"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "target")
			switch kind {
			case "missing":
				if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o755); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case "file":
				if err := os.WriteFile(path, nil, 0o600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case "empty path":
				path = ""
			}
			assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: path, RealPath: path}, "", "", "navigation")
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateNavigationPlainDirectory(t *testing.T) {
	plain := t.TempDir()
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: plain}, "", plain, "")

	r := gittest.New(t)
	nested := filepath.Join(r.Root, "plain")
	if err := os.Mkdir(nested, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// HasGit=false describes the selected directory, not its containing repo.
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: nested}, "", nested, "")

	alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "plain-alias")
	navigationSymlink(t, plain, alias)
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: alias, RealPath: navigationCanonical(t, plain)}, "", alias, "")
}

func TestValidateNavigationFailedGitDoesNotFallback(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
	if err := os.RemoveAll(expected.GitDir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, observation := range map[string]repo.Repo{
		"complete":    expected,
		"candidate":   {Path: r.Root, HasGit: true},
		"common only": {Path: r.Root, CommonDir: expected.CommonDir},
		"gitdir only": {Path: r.Root, GitDir: expected.GitDir},
		"main only":   {Path: r.Root, MainRoot: expected.MainRoot},
		"bare only":   {Path: r.Root, Bare: true},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), observation, "", "", "validate repository")
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateNavigationChild(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
	child := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child")
	r.Git("worktree", "add", "--detach", child, "main")
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, child, child, "")
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: r.Root, HasGit: true}, child, child, "")

	alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-alias")
	navigationSymlink(t, child, alias)
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, alias, alias, "")

	nested := filepath.Join(child, "source")
	if err := os.Mkdir(nested, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, nested, "", "registered worktree not found")

	other := gittest.New(t)
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, other.Root, "", "registered worktree not found")
	wrongParent := expected
	wrongParent.CommonDir = navigationExpected(t, other.Root).CommonDir
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), wrongParent, child, "", "Git common directory changed")
}

func TestValidateNavigationChildMissingOrPrunable(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []string{"missing", "prunable", "replaced Git", "unregistered"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := gittest.New(t)
			expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
			child := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child")
			r.Git("worktree", "add", "--detach", child, "main")
			selected := navigationExpected(t, child)
			ctx := gitx.WithObservations(t.Context())
			if _, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Root); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			wantError := ""
			switch state {
			case "missing":
				if err := os.RemoveAll(child); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				wantError = "inspect navigation directory"
			case "prunable", "replaced Git":
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(child, ".git")); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				wantError = "prunable"
				if state == "replaced Git" {
					r.GitIn(child, "init", "--initial-branch=main")
					wantError = "checkout Git common directory changed"
				}
			case "unregistered":
				if err := os.RemoveAll(selected.GitDir); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				wantError = "registered worktree not found"
			}
			assertNavigation(t, ctx, expected, child, "", wantError)
		})
	}
}

func TestValidateNavigationFreshRegistration(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	expected := navigationExpected(t, r.Root)
	ctx := gitx.WithObservations(t.Context())
	if _, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Root); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	child := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "new-child")
	r.Git("worktree", "add", "--detach", child, "main")
	assertNavigation(t, ctx, expected, child, child, "")
}

func TestValidateNavigationBare(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	bare := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "hub.git")
	r.Git("clone", "--bare", "--", r.Root, bare)
	physical := navigationCanonical(t, bare)
	expected := repo.Repo{Path: bare, RealPath: physical, GitDir: physical, CommonDir: physical, MainRoot: physical, HasGit: true, Bare: true}
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, "", bare, "")
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), repo.Repo{Path: bare, HasGit: true}, "", bare, "")

	child := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bare-child")
	r.GitIn(bare, "worktree", "add", "--detach", child, "main")
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, child, child, "")

	alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "hub-alias")
	navigationSymlink(t, bare, alias)
	expected.Path = alias
	assertNavigation(t, t.Context(), expected, "", alias, "")
}

func TestValidateNavigationCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	for _, observation := range []repo.Repo{{Path: t.TempDir()}, {Path: t.TempDir(), HasGit: true}} {
		got, err := repo.ValidateNavigation(ctx, observation, "")
		if got != "" || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("ValidateNavigation canceled = %q, %v", got, err)
		}
	}
}

func navigationExpected(t *testing.T, path string) repo.Repo {
	t.Helper()
	g, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return repo.Repo{Path: path, RealPath: navigationCanonical(t, path), GitDir: g.GitDir, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, MainRoot: g.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare}
}

func navigationCanonical(t *testing.T, path string) string {
	t.Helper()
	canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return canonical
}

func navigationSymlink(t *testing.T, target, alias string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := os.Symlink(target, alias); err != nil {
		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
	}
}

func assertNavigation(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, expected repo.Repo, checkout, want, wantError string) {
	t.Helper()
	got, err := repo.ValidateNavigation(ctx, expected, checkout)
	if wantError != "" {
		if got != "" || err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), wantError) {
			t.Fatalf("ValidateNavigation(%q, %q) = %q, %v; want error containing %q", expected.Path, checkout, got, err, wantError)
		}
		return
	}
	if err != nil || got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ValidateNavigation(%q, %q) = %q, %v; want %q", expected.Path, checkout, got, err, want)
	}
}
```
