)

type tuiRepoJob struct {
	index    int
	validate bool
	row      tui.RepoRow
}

type tuiRepoDone struct {
	job tuiRepoJob
	row tui.RepoRow
	err error
}

type tuiRepoRecord struct {
	row      tui.RepoRow
	complete bool
}

// collectTUIRepoStream owns admission, deduplication and publication. Only one
// cancellable permit request is outstanding; there is never a goroutine per
// queued repository. A slow favorite occupies its own slot, not a phase barrier.
func collectTUIRepoStream(ctx context.Context, metadata tuiRepoCatalog, repositories *tuiFuture[[]repo.Repo], live *tuiFuture[tuiRuntimeSnapshot], limiter *inventory.Limiter,
	validate func(context.Context, repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error), collect func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow,
	tasksErr error, publish func(string, tui.RepoRow)) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
	var records []tuiRepoRecord
	var favorites, ordinary []tuiRepoJob
	reserved := map[string]int{}
	known := map[string]bool{}
	for _, row := range metadata.seeds {
		index := len(records)
		records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
		favorites = append(favorites, tuiRepoJob{index: index, validate: true, row: row})
		for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo) {
			reserved[key]++
		}
	}
	var pending []repo.Repo
	admitDiscovered := func() {
		waiting := pending[:0]
		for _, r := range pending {
			keys := tuiRepoKeys(r)
			duplicate, held := false, false
			for _, key := range keys {
				duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
				held = held || reserved[key] > 0
			}
			if duplicate {
				continue
			}
			if held {
				waiting = append(waiting, r)
				continue
			}
			row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: metadata.asset(r)}
			job := tuiRepoJob{index: len(records), row: row}
			records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
			for _, key := range keys {
				known[key] = true
			}
			if row.Favorite() {
				favorites = append(favorites, job)
			} else {
				ordinary = append(ordinary, job)
			}
		}
		pending = waiting
	}

	completed := make(chan tuiRepoDone, 8)
	permits := make(chan func())
	var workers sync.WaitGroup
	workerCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer func() { cancel(); workers.Wait() }()
	var err error
	active, acquiring := 0, false
	discoveryReady, runtimeReady := repositories.ready, live.ready
	var runtimeSnapshot tuiRuntimeSnapshot
	var runtimeErr error
	runtimeDone := false
	join := func(row *tui.RepoRow) {
		row.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
		if row.Unavailable != "" {
			return
		}
		row.Pending = "runtime pending"
		if runtimeDone {
			if runtimeErr != nil {
				row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
				row.Pending = "runtime unavailable"
			} else {
				joinRuntime(row, runtimeSnapshot)
				row.Pending = ""
			}
		}
	}
	for {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
		}
		if !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) > 0 {
			acquiring = true
			workers.Go(func() {
				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(workerCtx)
				if !ok {
					return
				}
				select {
				case permits <- release:
				case <-workerCtx.Done():
					release()
				}
			})
		}
		if discoveryReady == nil && runtimeDone && active == 0 && !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) == 0 {
			break
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
		case <-discoveryReady:
			discoveryReady = nil
			err = errors.Join(err, repositories.err)
			pending = append(pending, repositories.value...)
			admitDiscovered()
		case <-runtimeReady:
			runtimeReady, runtimeDone = nil, true
			runtimeSnapshot, runtimeErr = live.value, live.err
			err = errors.Join(err, runtimeErr)
			for i := range records {
				if records[i].complete && records[i].row.Repo.Path != "" && records[i].row.Unavailable == "" {
					join(&records[i].row)
					publish("runtime", records[i].row)
				}
			}
		case release := <-permits:
			acquiring = false
			var job tuiRepoJob
			if len(favorites) > 0 {
				job, favorites = favorites[0], favorites[1:]
			} else {
				job, ordinary = ordinary[0], ordinary[1:]
			}
			active++
			workers.Go(func() {
				defer release()
				result := tuiRepoDone{job: job, row: job.row}
				if job.validate {
					result.row.Repo, result.err = validate(workerCtx, job.row.Repo)
				} else {
					result.row = collect(workerCtx, job.row)
				}
				select {
				case completed <- result:
				case <-workerCtx.Done():
				}
			})
		case result := <-completed:
			active--
			index, row := result.job.index, result.row
			if result.job.validate {
				for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(result.job.row.Repo) {
					reserved[key]--
				}
				if result.err != nil {
					row = result.job.row
					row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", result.err.Error()
					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %w", row.Repo.Path, result.err))
					// A replaced checkout at this path must not overwrite the
					// unavailable favorite with an apparently clean observation.
					for path := range canonicalRepoValues(row.Repo.Path) {
						known["path:"+path] = true
					}
					records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
					publish("enrichment", row)
				} else {
					keys, duplicate := tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo), false
					for _, key := range keys {
						duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
					}
					if duplicate {
						records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{}
					} else {
						for _, key := range keys {
							known[key] = true
						}
						records[index].row = row
						favorites = append(favorites, tuiRepoJob{index: index, row: row})
					}
				}
				admitDiscovered()
				continue
			}
			if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.GitKnown {
				row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", "repository Git observation unavailable"
				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok && main.StatusErr != nil {
					row.Unavailable = main.StatusErr.Error()
				}
				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %s", row.Repo.Path, row.Unavailable))
			}
			join(&row)
			records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
			publish("enrichment", row)
		}
	}
	rows := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(records))
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.complete && record.row.Repo.Path != "" {
			rows = append(rows, record.row)
		}
	}
	return rows, err
}

package tui

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
)

func favoriteTestRows() []RepoRow {
	var rows []RepoRow
	for _, name := range []string{"a", "b", "c", "d"} {
		rows = append(rows, RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: name, Path: "/" + name}, Asset: &catalog.Entry{
			ID: name, Kind: catalog.KindRepository, Name: name, Favorite: name == "b" || name == "d",
		}})
	}
	return rows
}

func TestRepoFavoritesStayAboveEverySortAndRespectFilter(t *testing.T) {
	for _, reverse := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, column := range []string{"", "repo"} {
			m := New(Actions{RepoSort: "name", RepoReverse: reverse}, nil, favoriteTestRows())
			m.view = ViewRepos
			m.tableSorts[int(ViewRepos)] = tableSort{column: column, descending: reverse}
			var names []string
			for _, row := range m.visibleRepos() {
				names = append(names, row.Repo.Name)
			}
			want := []string{"b", "d", "a", "c"}
			if reverse {
				want = []string{"d", "b", "c", "a"}
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(names, want) {
				t.Fatalf("reverse=%v column=%s: %v, want %v", reverse, column, names, want)
			}
			m.filter = "a"
			if rows := m.visibleRepos(); len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Repo.Name != "a" {
				t.Fatalf("favorites escaped filtering: %+v", rows)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestRepoFavoriteMutationKeepsFocusAndSurvivesOlderSnapshots(t *testing.T) {
	var calls int
	m := New(Actions{RepoSort: "name", Repos: RepoActions{SetFavorite: func(_ context.Context, row RepoRow, desired bool) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
		calls++
		asset := row.Asset.Clone()
		asset.Favorite, asset.Updated = desired, time.Unix(100, 0)
		return asset, nil
	}}}, nil, favoriteTestRows())
	m.view = ViewRepos
	m.setAt(1) // d, initially the second favorite
	selected := m.currentToken()
	next, command := m.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune("f")})
	m = next.(Model)
	if command == nil || !m.repoFavoriteBusy {
		t.Fatal("favorite setter not dispatched")
	}
	if _, duplicate := m.runListAction(listActionRepoFavorite); duplicate != nil {
		t.Fatal("second favorite mutation accepted while pending")
	}
	msg := command()
	next, reload := m.Update(msg)
	m = next.(Model)
	if reload != nil || m.repoFavoriteBusy || calls != 1 || m.currentToken() != selected {
		t.Fatalf("favorite mutation reloaded or moved focus: calls=%d reload=%v", calls, reload)
	}
	if row, _ := m.currentRepo(); row.Favorite() {
		t.Fatal("favorite was not removed")
	}

	generation := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadRefresh)
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Valid: true, Repos: favoriteTestRows()})
	if row, _ := m.currentRepo(); row.Repo.Name != "d" || row.Favorite() {
		t.Fatal("older final snapshot overwrote favorite or focus")
	}
	fresh := favoriteTestRows()
	fresh[3].Asset.Updated = time.Unix(101, 0)
	m.repos = fresh
	if row := m.visibleRepos()[1]; row.Repo.Name != "d" || !row.Favorite() {
		t.Fatal("newer catalog preference did not supersede local overlay")
	}
}

func TestRepoFavoriteFailureAndPendingMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("catalog write failed")
	rows := favoriteTestRows()
	rows[0].Pending, rows[0].Unavailable = "unavailable", "directory is missing"
	m := New(Actions{Repos: RepoActions{SetFavorite: func(context.Context, RepoRow, bool) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
		return nil, failure
	}}}, nil, rows[:1])
	m.view = ViewRepos
	next, command := m.runListAction(listActionRepoFavorite)
	if command == nil {
		t.Fatal("known catalog preference could not be changed while unavailable")
	}
	m = next.(Model)
	next, reload := m.Update(command())
	m = next.(Model)
	if reload != nil || !errors.Is(m.err, failure) || m.visibleRepos()[0].Favorite() || m.repoFavoriteBusy {
		t.Fatal("failed favorite mutation changed intent or reloaded")
	}
	if _, command := m.runListAction(listActionOpen); command != nil {
		t.Fatal("unavailable repository opened")
	}
}

func TestPendingRepositoryOpenUsesTargetCallback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, pending := range []string{"cached", "loading", "refreshing", "runtime pending"} {
		for _, key := range []string{"enter", "o", "menu"} {
			t.Run(pending+"/"+key, func(t *testing.T) {
				calls := 0
				m := New(Actions{OpenRepo: func(_ context.Context, row RepoRow) (OpenResult, error) {
					calls++
					if row.Pending != pending || row.Repo.Path != "/selected" {
						t.Fatalf("opening wrong row or clearing pending: %+v", row)
					}
					return OpenResult{Directory: row.Repo.Path}, nil
				}}, nil, []RepoRow{{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "selected", Path: "/selected"}, Pending: pending}})
				m.view = ViewRepos
				var next tea.Model
				var command tea.Cmd
				switch key {
				case "menu":
					next, command = m.runListAction(listActionOpen)
				case "enter":
					next, command = m.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter})
				default:
					next, command = m.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune(key)})
				}
				if command == nil {
					t.Fatalf("pending open blocked: %s", next.(Model).status)
				}
				msg := command()
				m = next.(Model)
				next, quit := m.Update(msg)
				if calls != 1 || quit == nil || next.(Model).chosen != "/selected" {
					t.Fatal("open did not complete independently of inventory")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestFavoriteProgressDoesNotLoseCacheOrDowngradeRows(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(Actions{RepoSort: "name"}, nil, nil)
	m.view = ViewRepos
	generation := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadInitial)
	favorite := favoriteTestRows()[1]
	favorite.Pending = "loading"
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "favorites", Valid: true, Repos: []RepoRow{favorite}})
	cached := favoriteTestRows()
	for i := range cached {
		cached[i].Pending = "cached"
	}
	m, accepted := m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Valid: true, Repos: cached})
	if !accepted || len(m.repos) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("provisional favorites blocked the remaining cached rows")
	}
	favorite.Pending = ""
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "enrichment", Valid: true, Repos: []RepoRow{favorite}})
	favorite.Pending = "loading"
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "favorites", Valid: true, Repos: []RepoRow{favorite}})
	if got := m.visibleRepos()[0]; got.Pending != "" || !strings.HasPrefix(favoriteRepoLabel(got), "★ ") {
		t.Fatal("late provisional favorite downgraded enriched data or lost its badge")
	}
}

package cli

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx/gittest"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
)

func TestRepositoryFavoritePersistsWithoutLosingMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	repository := gittest.New(t)
	git, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), repository.Root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets"))
	app := &App{Catalog: store, Registry: catalog.NewRegistry(store)}
	row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "test", Path: repository.Root, RealPath: git.Root, CommonDir: git.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true}}
	entry, err := setRepositoryFavorite(t.Context(), app, row, true)
	if err != nil || entry == nil || !entry.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("favorite: %+v, %v", entry, err)
	}
	entry, err = app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(e *catalog.Entry) error {
		e.Note, e.Tags = "keep this note", []string{"work"}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row.Asset = entry
	// A new store/registry observes durable intent, not a TUI/cache flag.
	app.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(store.Dir)
	app.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(app.Catalog)
	loaded, err := app.Registry.Get(entry.ID)
	if err != nil || !loaded.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("favorite did not survive reopen: %+v, %v", loaded, err)
	}
	entry, err = setRepositoryFavorite(t.Context(), app, row, false)
	if err != nil || entry.Favorite || entry.Note != "keep this note" || !entry.HasTag("work") {
		t.Fatalf("unfavorite lost metadata: %+v, %v", entry, err)
	}
	loaded, err = catalog.NewStore(store.Dir).Get(entry.ID)
	if err != nil || loaded.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("false favorite did not persist: %+v, %v", loaded, err)
	}
}

func TestRepositoryFavoriteMissingKnownAssetCanBeRemoved(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing")
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets"))
	app := &App{Catalog: store, Registry: catalog.NewRegistry(store)}
	entry := &catalog.Entry{Kind: catalog.KindRepository, Name: "missing", Favorite: true, Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{
		config.Hostname(): {State: catalog.LocationPresent, CurrentPath: path, RealPath: path},
	}}
	if err := store.Create(entry); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "missing", Path: path}, Asset: entry, Pending: "unavailable", Unavailable: "missing"}
	got, err := setRepositoryFavorite(t.Context(), app, row, false)
	if err != nil || got.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("remove missing favorite: %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestRepositoryFavoriteRejectsStaleUncatalogedTarget(t *testing.T) {
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets"))
	app := &App{Catalog: store, Registry: catalog.NewRegistry(store)}
	path := t.TempDir()
	row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "gone-git", Path: path, HasGit: true}}
	if _, err := setRepositoryFavorite(t.Context(), app, row, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing Git identity became a plain-directory favorite")
	}
	entries, err := store.List()
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("failed validation created catalog entries: %+v, %v", entries, err)
	}
	row.Repo.HasGit = false
	entry, err := setRepositoryFavorite(t.Context(), app, row, true)
	if err != nil || !entry.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("explicit plain-directory favorite: %+v, %v", entry, err)
	}
}

func TestRepositoryFavoriteHonorsCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets"))
	app := &App{Catalog: store, Registry: catalog.NewRegistry(store)}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	_, err := setRepositoryFavorite(ctx, app, tui.RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "plain", Path: t.TempDir()}}, true)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("canceled favorite was accepted")
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(store.Dir); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("canceled favorite touched the store: %v", err)
	}
}

package catalog_test

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
)

func TestFavoriteDefaultsFalseAndSurvivesCatalogUpdates(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	store := catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(root, "assets"))
	entry := sampleEntry(root)
	if err := store.Create(entry); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	contents, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(store.Dir, entry.ID+".toml"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(contents), "favorite") {
		t.Fatal("default false should preserve the existing TOML shape")
	}
	loaded, err := store.Get(entry.ID)
	if err != nil || loaded.Favorite {
		t.Fatalf("legacy entry default = %+v, %v", loaded, err)
	}
	registry := catalog.NewRegistry(store)
	for _, desired := range []bool{true, false} {
		updated, err := registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(e *catalog.Entry) error {
			e.Favorite = desired
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		reopened, err := catalog.NewStore(store.Dir).Get(entry.ID)
		if err != nil || reopened.Favorite != desired || updated.Clone().Favorite != desired {
			t.Fatalf("favorite %v did not round-trip: %+v, %v", desired, reopened, err)
		}
		if reopened.Note != loaded.Note || !reopened.HasTag("go") {
			t.Fatal("favorite update lost unrelated metadata")
		}
	}
}

51	func TestRepoCDUsesLoadedConfigAndBypassesEveryRuntimeSelection(t *testing.T) {

55		cmd := newRepoCDCmd(app)

60		family := &cobra.Command{Use: "repo"}

14	// ValidateNavigation checks a repository row against current local filesystem and
15	// Git observations. An empty checkoutPath selects expected.Path; otherwise it
16	// selects an exact registered checkout of that repository. The returned path is
17	// the original navigation spelling, including any bootstrap symlink alias.
18	//
19	// Only identity fields present in expected can be compared. These path-based
20	// observations are not durable identity witnesses and cannot detect a repository
21	// deleted and recreated with identical paths. Validation neither mutates state
22	// nor guarantees that the target remains unchanged after this call returns.
23	func ValidateNavigation(ctx context.Context, expected Repo, checkoutPath string) (string, error) {
24		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
25		defer cancel()
26		// Never let an inventory cycle's cached worktree list authorize navigation.

29			return "", err
30		}
31	
32		parent, err := navigationDirectory(expected.Path)
33		if err != nil {
34			return "", err
35		}
36		if err := navigationIdentity("repository target", parent, expected.RealPath); err != nil {
37			return "", err
38		}
39		gitKnown := expected.HasGit || expected.CommonDir != "" || expected.GitDir != "" || expected.MainRoot != "" || expected.Bare
40		if !gitKnown && checkoutPath == "" {
41			// An explicitly observed plain directory remains a valid navigation
42			// target, even when Git would discover a repository in an ancestor.
43			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
44				return "", err
45			}
46			return expected.Path, nil
47		}
48	
49		repository, err := discoverNavigationRepository(ctx, parent, "")
50		if err != nil {

52		}

54			{"Git common directory", repository.GitCommonDir, expected.CommonDir},
55			{"Git directory", repository.GitDir, expected.GitDir},
56			{"main checkout", repository.MainRoot, expected.MainRoot},
57		} {
58			if err := navigationIdentity(identity.label, identity.actual, identity.expected); err != nil {
59				return "", err
60			}
61		}
62		if expected.Bare && !repository.Bare {

64		}
65		if checkoutPath == "" {
66			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {

68			}
69			return expected.Path, nil
70		}
71	
72		checkout, err := navigationDirectory(checkoutPath)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", err
75		}
76		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, parent, checkout)
77		if err != nil {
78			if ctx.Err() != nil {
79				return "", ctx.Err()
80			}

144		}
145		return fmt.Errorf("%s changed: expected %q, found %q", label, canonical, actual)
146	}

| Library / SDK | import-and-call smoke script at the package boundary | [examples/library.md](examples/library.md) |

If nothing fits, start from the closest match and adapt. For a web
app, [examples/playwright.md](examples/playwright.md) - drive it with
`chromium-cli`, no custom driver needed. For a desktop app,
[examples/electron.md](examples/electron.md) - it has the `_electron`
REPL driver skeleton and the tmux wrapping.

## Drive it, don't just launch it

Launching with no interaction proves the entrypoint resolves. That's
not running the app - it's typechecking with extra steps. Drive it to
a point where a user would see something:

- CLI -> type a representative command, check the exit code and output.
- Server -> hit the route the diff touches with `curl`, read the body.
- TUI -> `send-keys` a navigation, `capture-pane` the result.
- GUI -> click the button, screenshot the window. **Look at the
  screenshot.** A blank frame is a failure to launch.

If the fallback pattern didn't work out of the box - you had to
install packages, set env vars, patch config, or write a driver -
recommend `/run-skill-generator` in your report so that work gets
captured as a project skill. If it just worked, don't.

````text
1	# Example: TUI / interactive terminal app
2	
3	Interactive terminal apps (text editors, REPLs, curses-based UIs) can't
4	be driven directly by an agent's bash tool - they take over the terminal.
5	The skill must show how to wrap them in `tmux` so the agent can send
6	input, capture output, and take screenshots.
7	
8	## The tmux pattern
9	
10	This is the standard approach:
11	
12	1. Start the TUI inside a detached tmux session
13	2. Send keystrokes with `tmux send-keys`
14	3. Read screen contents with `tmux capture-pane`
15	4. Clean up with `tmux kill-session`
16	
17	The skill's `SKILL.md` should present this as the primary way to drive
18	the app. A small `driver.sh` that wraps the launch+attach sequence can
19	live in the skill directory, but for most TUIs the raw tmux commands in
20	the skill body are enough.
21	
22	## Example snippet
23	
24	> ## Run (interactive, for agents)
25	>
26	> Start the TUI inside tmux:
27	>
28	> ```bash
29	> tmux new-session -d -s app -x 120 -y 40 './myapp'
30	> ```
31	>
32	> Poll until the ready marker appears (faster + more reliable than a fixed sleep -
33	> returns the instant the app is up, fails loudly if it isn't):
34	>
35	> ```bash
36	> timeout 10 bash -c 'until tmux capture-pane -t app -p | grep -q "Ready"; do sleep 0.2; done'
37	> tmux capture-pane -t app -p
38	> ```
39	>
40	> Send input (this example navigates to the Settings screen and toggles
41	> an option):
42	>
43	> ```bash
44	> tmux send-keys -t app 's'
45	> timeout 5 bash -c 'until tmux capture-pane -t app -p | grep -q "Settings"; do sleep 0.2; done'
46	> tmux send-keys -t app 'Down' 'Down' 'Space'  # navigate + toggle
47	> timeout 5 bash -c 'until tmux capture-pane -t app -p | grep -qF "[x]"; do sleep 0.2; done'
48	> tmux capture-pane -t app -p
49	> ```
50	>
51	> If you find yourself writing more than a couple of these poll lines, pull
52	> them into a `wait_for()` helper in a `driver.sh` next to the skill.
53	>
54	> Quit:
55	>
56	> ```bash
57	> tmux send-keys -t app 'q'
58	> tmux kill-session -t app 2>/dev/null || true
59	> ```
60	>
61	> ### Key reference
62	>
63	> | Key | Action |
64	> |---|---|
65	> | `j` / `k` or `Down` / `Up` | Navigate list |
66	> | `Enter` | Select |
67	> | `s` | Settings |
68	> | `q` | Quit |
69	
70	## Details worth documenting
71	
72	- **Terminal size.** Some TUIs break or hide content at small widths.
73	  Specify a known-good size in the `tmux new-session -x -y` args.
74	- **Startup time.** Poll for a ready marker (`until tmux capture-pane | grep -q X`)
75	  rather than a fixed `sleep N` - returns the instant the app is up, and fails
76	  usefully when it never does. Say what string means ready.
77	- **Keybinding reference.** A table of the main keys. This is the "API"
78	  of a TUI - an agent needs it to drive the app.
79	- **Exit cleanly.** Show the quit keystroke *and* `tmux kill-session` as
80	  a fallback.
81	- **Color/unicode quirks.** If `capture-pane` output is hard to read,
82	  note flags that help (`-e` for escape sequences, `-J` to join wrapped
83	  lines).
84	
85	## Also document the direct invocation
86	
87	For a human running the app interactively, tmux is overkill. Include
88	the one-liner too:
89	
90	> ## Run (direct, for humans)
91	>
92	> ```bash
93	> ./myapp
94	> ```
95	>
96	> Press `q` to quit.
97
````

package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx/gittest"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/inventory"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/perftrace"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
)

func loaderTestApp(t *testing.T, roots ...string) *App {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", t.TempDir())
	cfg := config.Config{}
	cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = roots
	cfg.Paths.StateDir = t.TempDir()
	return &App{Cfg: cfg, Catalog: catalog.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "assets")),
		Tasks: task.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "tasks")), trace: perftrace.New(64)}
}

func loaderFavorite(t *testing.T, app *App, r repo.Repo) *catalog.Entry {
	t.Helper()
	entry := &catalog.Entry{Kind: catalog.KindRepository, Name: r.Name, Favorite: true,
		Locations: map[string]catalog.Location{configHostname(): {
			State: catalog.LocationPresent, CurrentPath: r.Path, RealPath: r.RealPath, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
		}}}
	if err := app.Catalog.Create(entry); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return entry
}

func loaderDiscoveredRepo(t *testing.T, path string) repo.Repo {
	t.Helper()
	g, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return repo.Repo{Name: filepath.Base(path), Path: path, RealPath: g.MainRoot,
		GitDir: g.GitDir, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, MainRoot: g.MainRoot, HasGit: true}
}

func waitRepoResult(t *testing.T, results <-chan tui.LocalResult, phase string) tui.LocalResult {
	t.Helper()
	timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Second)
	defer timer.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case result, ok := <-results:
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("result stream ended before REPOS phase %q", phase)
			}
			if result.View == tui.ViewRepos && result.Phase == phase {
				return result
			}
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for REPOS phase %q", phase)
		}
	}
}

func awaitLoaderValue[T any](t *testing.T, values <-chan T) T {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case value := <-values:
		return value
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("timed out waiting for loader barrier")
		var zero T
		return zero
	}
}

func TestTUILocalLoaderFavoriteBeforeDiscoveryAndRuntimeRejoin(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	discovered := loaderDiscoveredRepo(t, r.Root)
	app := loaderTestApp(t, r.Root)
	entry := loaderFavorite(t, app, discovered)
	before, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(app.Catalog.Dir, entry.ID+".toml"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	discoveryGate, runtimeGate := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	loader := &tuiLocalLoader{app: app,
		discoverRepos: func(ctx context.Context) ([]repo.Repo, error) {
			select {
			case <-discoveryGate:
				return []repo.Repo{discovered}, nil
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return nil, ctx.Err()
			}
		},
		loadRuntime: func(ctx context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) {
			select {
			case <-runtimeGate:
				return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{}, ctx.Err()
			}
		},
		collectTries: func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) { return nil, nil },
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	load := loader.Start(ctx, tui.LocalLoadRequest{ReposGeneration: 42})
	seeds := waitRepoResult(t, load.Results, "favorites")
	if seeds.Generation != 42 || len(seeds.Repos) != 1 || !seeds.Repos[0].Favorite() || seeds.Repos[0].Pending == "" {
		t.Fatalf("cold-start seeds = %+v", seeds)
	}
	enriched := waitRepoResult(t, load.Results, "enrichment")
	if enriched.Generation != 42 || len(enriched.Repos) != 1 || !enriched.Repos[0].GitKnown || enriched.Repos[0].Pending != "runtime pending" {
		t.Fatalf("favorite did not enrich before discovery/runtime: %+v", enriched)
	}
	close(runtimeGate)
	rejoined := waitRepoResult(t, load.Results, "runtime")
	if len(rejoined.Repos) != 1 || rejoined.Repos[0].Pending != "" || rejoined.Repos[0].Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("runtime-ready row = %+v", rejoined)
	}
	// Full discovery is still blocked: the runtime update cannot be a final join.
	close(discoveryGate)
	final := waitRepoResult(t, load.Results, "")
	if final.Err != nil || len(final.Repos) != 1 || !final.Repos[0].Favorite() || final.Repos[0].Pending != "" {
		t.Fatalf("final favorite = %+v", final)
	}
	for range load.Results {
	}
	after, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(app.Catalog.Dir, entry.ID+".toml"))
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(before, after) {
		t.Fatalf("discovery wrote catalog: %v", err)
	}
	cached, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "repos-v1.json"))
	if err != nil || bytes.Contains(cached, []byte(`"favorite"`)) || bytes.Contains(cached, []byte(entry.ID)) {
		t.Fatalf("cache contains preferences or was not written: %s, %v", cached, err)
	}
}

func readyLoaderFuture[T any](value T, err error) *tuiFuture[T] {
	ready := make(chan struct{})
	close(ready)
	return &tuiFuture[T]{ready: ready, value: value, err: err}
}

func syntheticLoaderRow(root, name string, favorite bool) tui.RepoRow {
	return tui.RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: name, Path: filepath.Join(root, name), RealPath: filepath.Join(root, name)},
		Asset: &catalog.Entry{ID: name, Kind: catalog.KindRepository, Favorite: favorite}}
}

func TestTUIRepoStreamSlowFavoriteDoesNotBlockOrdinaryAndDeduplicates(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	favorite := syntheticLoaderRow(root, "favorite", true)
	ordinary := syntheticLoaderRow(root, "ordinary", false)
	gate, started := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	published := make(chan tui.RepoRow, 8)
	var collects atomic.Int32
	done := startTUIFuture(func() ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
		return collectTUIRepoStream(t.Context(), tuiRepoCatalog{seeds: []tui.RepoRow{favorite}},
			readyLoaderFuture([]repo.Repo{favorite.Repo, ordinary.Repo}, nil),
			readyLoaderFuture(tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil), inventory.NewLimiter(2),
			func(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) {
				close(started)
				select {
				case <-gate:
					return r, nil
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return r, ctx.Err()
				}
			}, func(_ context.Context, row tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow { collects.Add(1); return row }, nil,
			func(_ string, row tui.RepoRow) { published <- row })
	})
	awaitLoaderValue(t, started)
	row := awaitLoaderValue(t, published)
	if row.Repo.Path != ordinary.Repo.Path {
		t.Fatalf("slow favorite blocked unrelated row: %+v", row)
	}
	close(gate)
	awaitLoaderValue(t, done.ready)
	if done.err != nil || len(done.value) != 2 || collects.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("dedup/final rows = %d, collects=%d, err=%v", len(done.value), collects.Load(), done.err)
	}
}

func TestTUIRepoStreamFavoriteAdmissionAndSharedBound(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	var seeds []tui.RepoRow
	var discovered []repo.Repo
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		row := syntheticLoaderRow(root, fmt.Sprintf("favorite-%02d", i), true)
		seeds = append(seeds, row)
		discovered = append(discovered, row.Repo)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		discovered = append(discovered, syntheticLoaderRow(root, fmt.Sprintf("ordinary-%02d", i), false).Repo)
	}
	limiter := inventory.NewLimiter(8)
	// Simulate TASKS retaining three of the shared eight permits.
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		release, ok := limiter.Acquire(t.Context())
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("failed to reserve task permit")
		}
		defer release()
	}
	started, gate := make(chan bool, 32), make(chan struct{})
	var active, maximum, validations, collects atomic.Int32
	work := func(ctx context.Context, favorite bool) {
		n := active.Add(1)
		for old := maximum.Load(); n > old && !maximum.CompareAndSwap(old, n); old = maximum.Load() {
		}
		started <- favorite
		select {
		case <-gate:
		case <-ctx.Done():
		}
		active.Add(-1)
	}
	done := startTUIFuture(func() ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
		return collectTUIRepoStream(t.Context(), tuiRepoCatalog{seeds: seeds}, readyLoaderFuture(discovered, nil),
			readyLoaderFuture(tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil), limiter,
			func(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) {
				validations.Add(1)
				work(ctx, true)
				return r, nil
			}, func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow {
				collects.Add(1)
				work(ctx, row.Favorite())
				return row
			}, nil, func(string, tui.RepoRow) {})
	})
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		if !awaitLoaderValue(t, started) {
			t.Fatal("nonfavorite admitted while favorites remained queued")
		}
	}
	select {
	case <-started:
		t.Fatal("enrichment exceeded shared eight-slot limit")
	default:
	}
	close(gate)
	awaitLoaderValue(t, done.ready)
	if done.err != nil || len(done.value) != 22 || validations.Load() != 10 || collects.Load() != 22 || maximum.Load() > 5 {
		t.Fatalf("rows=%d validations=%d collects=%d maximum=%d err=%v", len(done.value), validations.Load(), collects.Load(), maximum.Load(), done.err)
	}
}

func TestTUIRepoStreamCancellationReleasesAdmittedWork(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	var seeds []tui.RepoRow
	for i := 0; i < 30; i++ {
		seeds = append(seeds, syntheticLoaderRow(root, fmt.Sprint(i), true))
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	started := make(chan struct{}, 8)
	limiter := inventory.NewLimiter(8)
	var active atomic.Int32
	done := startTUIFuture(func() ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
		return collectTUIRepoStream(ctx, tuiRepoCatalog{seeds: seeds}, readyLoaderFuture([]repo.Repo{}, nil),
			readyLoaderFuture(tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil), limiter,
			func(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) {
				active.Add(1)
				defer active.Add(-1)
				started <- struct{}{}
				<-ctx.Done()
				return r, ctx.Err()
			}, func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow { panic("canceled favorite enriched") }, nil, func(string, tui.RepoRow) {})
	})
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		awaitLoaderValue(t, started)
	}
	cancel()
	awaitLoaderValue(t, done.ready)
	if !errors.Is(done.err, context.Canceled) || active.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cancellation err=%v active=%d", done.err, active.Load())
	}
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		permitCtx, permitCancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), time.Second)
		release, ok := limiter.Acquire(permitCtx)
		permitCancel()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("canceled loader retained a shared permit")
		}
		defer release()
	}
}

func TestTUILocalLoaderCancellationDoesNotReplaceCache(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	app := loaderTestApp(t, root)
	row := syntheticLoaderRow(root, "favorite", true)
	loaderFavorite(t, app, row.Repo)
	path := filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "repos-v1.json")
	key := repo.SnapshotKey(app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), app.Cfg.StateDir())
	if err := repo.WriteSnapshot(path, repo.Snapshot{Fingerprint: key, ObservedAt: time.Now(), Rows: []repo.CachedRow{{Repo: row.Repo}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	started := make(chan struct{})
	loader := &tuiLocalLoader{app: app,
		discoverFavorite: func(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) { close(started); <-ctx.Done(); return r, ctx.Err() },
		discoverRepos: func(ctx context.Context) ([]repo.Repo, error) { <-ctx.Done(); return nil, ctx.Err() },
		loadRuntime: func(context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) { return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil },
		collectTries: func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) { return nil, nil },
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	load := loader.Start(ctx, tui.LocalLoadRequest{})
	cached := waitRepoResult(t, load.Results, "cache")
	if len(cached.Repos) != 1 || !cached.Repos[0].Favorite() {
		t.Fatalf("current preference not joined to cache: %+v", cached)
	}
	awaitLoaderValue(t, started)
	cancel()
	for range load.Results {
	}
	after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(before, after) {
		t.Fatalf("cancellation replaced cache: %v", err)
	}
}

	physical := t.TempDir()
	index := t.TempDir()
	alias := filepath.Join(index, "api")
	if err := os.Symlink(physical, alias); err != nil {
		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
	}
	app := loaderTestApp(t, index)
	loaderFavorite(t, app, repo.Repo{Name: "api", Path: physical, RealPath: physical})

	if err != nil || len(metadata.seeds) != 1 {

	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(container, ".git"), 0o755); err != nil {

	}
}

func TestTUIFavoriteTargetRejectsChangedIdentityAndAcceptsPlainDirectory(t *testing.T) {

	expected := loaderDiscoveredRepo(t, first.Root)
	expected.CommonDir = loaderDiscoveredRepo(t, second.Root).CommonDir
	if _, err := discoverTUIFavorite(t.Context(), expected); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("favorite accepted changed Git common directory")
	}
	plain := t.TempDir()
	actual, err := discoverTUIFavorite(t.Context(), repo.Repo{Name: "plain", Path: plain, RealPath: plain})
	if err != nil || actual.HasGit {
		t.Fatalf("plain target = %+v, %v", actual, err)
	}
}

	calls := 0

		readyLoaderFuture(tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil), inventory.NewLimiter(8), discoverTUIFavorite,
		func(_ context.Context, row tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow { calls++; row.GitKnown = true; return row }, nil, func(string, tui.RepoRow) {})

	}

406	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
407		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
408		if ctx == nil {
409			ctx = context.Background()
410		}
411		out := RepoContext{
412			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime, RuntimeErr: opts.RuntimeErr,
413			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
414			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
415		}
416		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
417		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
418		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
419	
420		var (
421			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
422			err       error
423		)
424		if queryPath == "" {
425			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
426		} else {
427			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
428		}
429		if err != nil {
430			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
431			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
432			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
433			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
434			finishRepoContext(&out)
435			return out
436		}
437		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
438		out.WorktreeCount = 0
439		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
440		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
441			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
442			if canonicalPath == "" {
443				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
444			}
445			exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(worktree.Path)

448				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,

452			}

454				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
455					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
456				})
457			}
458			if worktree.Main {
459				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
460					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
461				})
462			} else {
463				out.WorktreeCount++
464			}

466		}

469		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
470		assignTasks(&out, tasks)

483		if opts.RuntimeObserved {

20	type tuiRepoDone struct {
21		job     tuiRepoJob
22		row     tui.RepoRow
23		err     error
24		proceed chan bool
25	}
26	
27	type tuiRepoRecord struct {
28		row      tui.RepoRow
29		complete bool
30	}
31	
32	// collectTUIRepoStream owns admission, deduplication and publication. Only one
33	// cancellable permit request is outstanding; there is never a goroutine per
34	// queued repository. A slow favorite occupies its own slot, not a phase barrier.
35	func collectTUIRepoStream(ctx context.Context, metadata tuiRepoCatalog, repositories *tuiFuture[[]repo.Repo], live *tuiFuture[tuiRuntimeSnapshot], limiter *inventory.Limiter,
36		validate func(context.Context, repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error), collect func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow,
37		tasksErr error, publish func(string, tui.RepoRow)) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
38		var records []tuiRepoRecord
39		var favorites, ordinary []tuiRepoJob
40		reserved := map[string]int{}
41		known := map[string]bool{}
42		owners := map[string]int{}
43		for _, row := range metadata.seeds {
44			index := len(records)
45			records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
46			favorites = append(favorites, tuiRepoJob{index: index, validate: true, row: row})
47			for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo) {
48				reserved[key]++
49			}
50		}
51		var pending []repo.Repo
52		admitDiscovered := func() {
53			waiting := pending[:0]
54			for _, r := range pending {
55				keys := tuiRepoKeys(r)
56				duplicate, held := false, false
57				for _, key := range keys {
58					duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
59					held = held || reserved[key] > 0
60				}
61				if duplicate {
62					for _, key := range keys {
63						if known[key] {
64							owner := owners[key]
65							if preferTUIRepoAlias(&records[owner].row, r) && records[owner].complete {
66								publish("enrichment", records[owner].row)
67							}
68							break
69						}
70					}
71					continue
72				}
73				if held {
74					waiting = append(waiting, r)
75					continue
76				}
77				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: metadata.asset(r)}
78				job := tuiRepoJob{index: len(records), row: row}
79				records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
80				for _, key := range keys {
81					known[key], owners[key] = true, job.index
82				}
83				if row.Favorite() {
84					favorites = append(favorites, job)
85				} else {
86					ordinary = append(ordinary, job)
87				}
88			}
89			pending = waiting
90		}
91	
92		completed := make(chan tuiRepoDone, 8)
93		permits := make(chan func())
94		var workers sync.WaitGroup
95		workerCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
96		defer func() { cancel(); workers.Wait() }()
97		var err error
98		active, acquiring := 0, false
99		discoveryReady, runtimeReady := repositories.ready, live.ready
100		var runtimeSnapshot tuiRuntimeSnapshot
101		var runtimeErr error
102		runtimeDone := false
103		join := func(row *tui.RepoRow) {
104			row.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
105			if row.Unavailable != "" {
106				return
107			}
108			row.Pending = "runtime pending"
109			if runtimeDone {
110				if runtimeErr != nil {
111					row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
112					row.Pending = "runtime unavailable"
113				} else {
114					joinRuntime(row, runtimeSnapshot)
115					row.Pending = ""
116				}
117			}
118		}
119		for {
120			if ctx.Err() != nil {
121				return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
122			}
123			if !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) > 0 {
124				acquiring = true
125				workers.Go(func() {
126					release, ok := limiter.Acquire(workerCtx)
127					if !ok {
128						return
129					}
130					select {
131					case permits <- release:
132					case <-workerCtx.Done():
133						release()
134					}
135				})
136			}
137			if discoveryReady == nil && runtimeDone && active == 0 && !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) == 0 {
138				break
139			}
140			select {
141			case <-ctx.Done():
142				return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
143			case <-discoveryReady:
144				discoveryReady = nil
145				err = errors.Join(err, repositories.err)
146				pending = append(pending, repositories.value...)
147				admitDiscovered()
148			case <-runtimeReady:
149				runtimeReady, runtimeDone = nil, true
150				runtimeSnapshot, runtimeErr = live.value, live.err
151				err = errors.Join(err, runtimeErr)
152				for i := range records {
153					if records[i].complete && records[i].row.Repo.Path != "" && records[i].row.Unavailable == "" {
154						join(&records[i].row)
155						publish("runtime", records[i].row)
156					}
157				}
158			case release := <-permits:
159				acquiring = false
160				var job tuiRepoJob
161				if len(favorites) > 0 {
162					job, favorites = favorites[0], favorites[1:]
163				} else {
164					job, ordinary = ordinary[0], ordinary[1:]
165				}
166				active++
167				workers.Go(func() {
168					defer release()
169					result := tuiRepoDone{job: job, row: job.row}
170					if job.validate {
171						result.row.Repo, result.err = validate(workerCtx, job.row.Repo)
172						if result.err == nil {
173							// Keep the admitted slot through validation and enrichment.
174							// Only identity arbitration returns to the dispatcher.
175							result.proceed = make(chan bool, 1)
176							select {
177							case completed <- result:
178							case <-workerCtx.Done():
179								return
180							}
181							select {
182							case proceed := <-result.proceed:
183								if !proceed {
184									return
185								}
186							case <-workerCtx.Done():
187								return
188							}
189							result.proceed, result.job.validate = nil, false
190							result.row = collect(workerCtx, result.row)
191						}
192					} else {
193						result.row = collect(workerCtx, job.row)
194					}
195					select {
196					case completed <- result:
197					case <-workerCtx.Done():
198					}
199				})
200			case result := <-completed:
201				if result.proceed == nil {
202					active--
203				}
204				index, row := result.job.index, result.row
205				if result.job.validate {
206					for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(result.job.row.Repo) {
207						reserved[key]--
208					}
209					if result.err != nil {
210						row = result.job.row
211						row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", result.err.Error()
212						err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %w", row.Repo.Path, result.err))
213						// A replaced checkout at this path must not overwrite the
214						// unavailable favorite with an apparently clean observation.
215						for path := range canonicalRepoValues(row.Repo.Path) {
216							known["path:"+path], owners["path:"+path] = true, index
217						}
218						records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
219						publish("enrichment", row)
220					} else {
221						keys, duplicate := tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo), false
222						for _, key := range keys {
223							duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
224						}
225						if duplicate {
226							records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{}
227							active--
228							result.proceed <- false
229						} else {
230							for _, key := range keys {
231								known[key], owners[key] = true, index
232							}
233							records[index].row = row
234							result.proceed <- true
235						}
236					}
237					admitDiscovered()
238					continue
239				}
240				if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.GitKnown {
241					row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", "repository Git observation unavailable"
242					if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok && main.StatusErr != nil {
243						row.Unavailable = main.StatusErr.Error()
244					}
245					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %s", row.Repo.Path, row.Unavailable))
246				}
247				preferTUIRepoAlias(&row, records[index].row.Repo)
248				join(&row)
249				records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
250				publish("enrichment", row)
251			}
252		}
253		rows := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(records))
254		for _, record := range records {
255			if record.complete && record.row.Repo.Path != "" {
256				rows = append(rows, record.row)
257			}
258		}
259		return rows, err
260	}

17	// Preferences are read from the durable catalog, never from the observation
18	// cache. This snapshot is read-only and scoped to one load generation.
19	type tuiRepoCatalog struct {
20		entries []*catalog.Entry
21		seeds   []tui.RepoRow
22		host    string
23	}
24	
25	func readTUIRepoCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App) (tuiRepoCatalog, error) {
26		out := tuiRepoCatalog{host: configHostname()}
27		if app.Catalog == nil {
28			return out, nil
29		}
30		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
31		if err != nil {
32			return out, fmt.Errorf("catalog metadata: %w", err)
33		}
34		out.entries = entries
35		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
36			err = errors.Join(err, diagnostic)
37		}
38		claimed := map[string]string{}
39		for _, entry := range entries {
40			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(out.host)
41			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
42				continue
43			}
44			for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(repo.Repo{Path: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath, CommonDir: location.GitCommonDir}) {
45				if owner := claimed[key]; owner != "" && owner != entry.ID {
46					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("catalog assets %s and %s match the same local repository", owner, entry.ID))
47				} else {
48					claimed[key] = entry.ID
49				}
50			}
51		}
52		for _, entry := range entries {
53			if ctx.Err() != nil {
54				return out, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
55			}
56			if !entry.Favorite || entry.Kind != catalog.KindRepository {
57				continue
58			}
59			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(out.host)
60			if !ok || location.CurrentPath == "" {
61				continue
62			}
63			for _, root := range app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots() {
64				covered, scopeErr := repo.PathDiscoverableFromRoot(root, location.CurrentPath, repo.DefaultOptions())
65				if scopeErr != nil {
66					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s discovery scope: %w", entry.Title(), scopeErr))
67					continue
68				}
69				if !covered {
70					continue
71				}
72				category := ""
73				if relative, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, location.CurrentPath); relErr == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
74					category = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(relative))
75					if category == "." {
76						category = ""
77					}
78				}
79				out.seeds = append(out.seeds, tui.RepoRow{
80					Repo: repo.Repo{Name: filepath.Base(location.CurrentPath), Path: location.CurrentPath,
81						RealPath: location.RealPath, CommonDir: location.GitCommonDir,
82						Root: root, Category: category, HasGit: location.GitCommonDir != ""},
83					Asset: entry.Clone(), Pending: "loading",
84				})
85				break
86			}
87		}
88		return out, err
89	}

91	func (c tuiRepoCatalog) asset(repository repo.Repo) *catalog.Entry {
92		var match *catalog.Entry
93		for _, entry := range c.entries {
94			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(c.host)
95			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
96				continue
97			}
98			if match != nil {
99				// Ambiguous metadata must not acquire authority through discovery.
100				return nil
101			}
102			match = entry
103		}
104		if match == nil {
105			return nil
106		}
107		return match.Clone()
108	}

110	func discoverTUIFavorite(ctx context.Context, expected repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) {
111		if _, err := repo.ValidateNavigation(ctx, expected, ""); err != nil {
112			return expected, err
113		}
114		g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, expected.Path)
115		if err != nil {
116			if !expected.HasGit && errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
117				// A failed Git marker is not an explicitly observed plain directory.
118				if _, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(expected.Path, ".git")); os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
119					expected.RealPath = canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path)
120					return expected, nil
121				}
122			}
123			// Discover's --show-toplevel is rejected by bare hubs. Navigation has
124			// already checked the expected identity; obtain the actual bare fields
125			// with Git rather than accepting a filesystem skeleton as authority.
126			out, bareErr := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, expected.Path, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-dir", "--git-common-dir", "--is-bare-repository")
127			fields := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out), "\n")
128			if bareErr != nil || len(fields) != 3 || fields[2] != "true" {
129				return expected, err
130			}
131			g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir = canonicalRepoValue(fields[0]), canonicalRepoValue(fields[1])
132			if g.GitDir == "" || g.GitCommonDir == "" {
133				return expected, err
134			}
135			g.MainRoot, g.Bare = g.GitCommonDir, true
136		}
137		if !expected.HasGit && !g.Bare && canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path) != g.Root {
138			// Preserve an observed plain directory below another repository; Git's
139			// ancestor lookup must not silently change which target this row means.
140			expected.RealPath = canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path)
141			return expected, nil
142		}
143		if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
144			return expected, errors.New("favorite target is a linked worktree, not a repository root")
145		}
146		expected.RealPath, expected.GitDir, expected.CommonDir = g.MainRoot, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir
147		expected.MainRoot, expected.HasGit, expected.Bare = g.MainRoot, true, g.Bare
148		if info, statErr := os.Lstat(expected.Path); statErr == nil {
149			expected.Symlink = info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
150		}
151		return expected, nil
152	}
153	
154	// A targeted physical-path seed must not erase the human navigation alias
155	// chosen by discovery. Presentation changes do not repeat Git enrichment.
156	func preferTUIRepoAlias(row *tui.RepoRow, alias repo.Repo) bool {
157		if !alias.Symlink || row.Repo.Symlink {
158			return false
159		}
160		row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.Name = alias.Path, alias.Name
161		row.Repo.Root, row.Repo.Category, row.Repo.Symlink = alias.Root, alias.Category, true
162		if row.Context.Repo.Path != "" {
163			row.Context.Repo = row.Repo
164		}
165		return true
166	}
167	
168	// Keys use physical paths and Git common directories, never display names.
169	// Seed keys reserve only potentially matching work until target validation;
170	// only freshly validated keys authorize deduplication of enrichment.
171	func tuiRepoKeys(r repo.Repo) []string {
172		var keys []string
173		if common := canonicalRepoValue(r.CommonDir); common != "" {
174			keys = append(keys, "git:"+common)
175		}
176		for path := range canonicalRepoValues(r.Path, r.RealPath) {
177			keys = append(keys, "path:"+path)
178		}
179		return keys
180	}

262				err = errors.Join(tasksErr, reposErr, runtimeErr)
263				if ctx.Err() == nil && (err == nil || discovered != nil) {

265					rows, collectErr = l.collectRepos(ctx, tracked, discovered, live, limiter)
266					err = errors.Join(err, collectErr)
267				}
268			}
269			if streaming && err == nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
270				snapshot := repo.Snapshot{Fingerprint: key, ObservedAt: time.Now()}
271				for _, r := range rows {
272					snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, repo.CachedRow{Repo: r.Repo, Status: r.Status, GitKnown: r.GitKnown, LastActivity: r.LastActivity, Try: r.IsTry()})
273				}
274				_ = repo.WriteSnapshot(cachePath, snapshot)
275			}
276			send(tui.LocalResult{View: tui.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration, Repos: rows, Valid: !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil), Err: err})
277		})
278		producers.Go(func() {
279			runtimeSnapshot, err := runtimeState.wait(ctx)
280			var rows []tui.TryRow
281			if err == nil {

283					View: perftrace.ViewTries, Generation: request.TriesGeneration,
284				})
285				rows, err = collectTries(ctx, request.ShowAllTries, runtimeSnapshot)
286				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
287			}
288			send(tui.LocalResult{
289				View: tui.ViewTries, Generation: request.TriesGeneration,
290				Tries: rows, Valid: !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil), Err: err,
291			})
292		})
293		go func() {
294			producers.Wait()
295			// Discovery's candidate callback is also a producer. On cancellation,
296			// wait for it to leave before closing the result stream.
297			<-repositories.ready
298			close(results)
299		}()

已實作，可以在專案目錄用 **`./dev`** 試：

- **`f` 收藏／取消收藏**：顯示 `★`、置頂，重啟後仍保留；也能從動作選單操作。
- **收藏優先更新**：啟動與刷新時先處理收藏，其他 repo 繼續背景掃描。
- **開啟不用等全量掃描**：Enter／`o` 只驗證選中的目標後開啟，所有 REPOS 項目都受益，不限收藏。
- 搜尋、原有排序與 worktree 分組保留，重新排序不會讓游標跳到另一個 repo。

4039	func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
4040		switch msg.String() {
4041		case "esc":
4042			m.mode = modeList
4043			m.input.Blur()
4044			m.setActiveFilter("")
4045			m.setAt(0)
4046			return m, nil
4047		case "enter":
4048			m.mode = modeList
4049			m.input.Blur()
4050			return m, nil
4051		case "down":
4052			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
4053			return m, nil
4054		case "up":
4055			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
4056			return m, nil
4057		}
4058		previous := m.input.Value()
4059		var cmd tea.Cmd
4060		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
4061		// Narrow live when the query changes, but let cursor-only edits retain
4062		// the selected result. Letters (including j/k) remain search text.
4063		if m.input.Value() != previous {
4064			m.setActiveFilter(m.input.Value())
4065			m.setAt(0)
4066		}
4067		return m, cmd
4068	}

73	Enter 保留查詢與選取並離開輸入，不會開啟該列；回到清單後再按 Enter，才執行

1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4	
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6	
7	## [Unreleased]
8	
9	### Added
10	
11	- REPOS repository favorites: `f` or the action menu toggles a durable catalog
12	  favorite, shown with `★` and grouped first without overriding filters or the
13	  ordering within each group. Current-host favorites within discovery scope
14	  appear provisionally even without a cache and receive priority enrichment;
15	  ordinary discovery continues and unavailable targets retain their favorite.
16	- Bilingual research on human/agent work items, proposal triage and cross-devbox
17	  handoffs compares Markdown, hosted trackers, td/Sidecar, Beads/Dolt and Herdr.
18	  Task guidance distinguishes durable outcomes from change streams and agent
19	  sessions, with staged trial criteria before adding dev integrations.
20	
21	### Changed
22	
23	- Lowercase `f` is now reserved for REPOS favorites. Custom tools previously
24	  bound to it must move to another available key, such as uppercase `F`.
25	- REPOS Enter/`o` validates the exact selected directory, Git common-directory
26	  identity and linked-worktree registration at action time, allowing navigation
27	  from cached/loading/refreshing/runtime-pending rows without waiting for global
28	  inventory or runtime listing. Runtime resolution and native handoff latency
29	  remain; dirty-state, lifecycle, cleanup and batch observation guards are unchanged.
30	
31	## [0.3.3] - 2026-09-25
32	
33	### Added
34	
35	- `dev repo cd <repo>` provides shell-only repository navigation, equivalent
36	  to `dev repo open <repo> --runtime none`, including argument completion and
37	  the shell wrapper's directory handoff. It never opens a multiplexer.
38	- REMOTE can expand a repository into on-demand GitHub PR/GitLab MR pages,
39	  inspect checks and diffnav previews, and open an exact task-free worktree or
40	  independent Try clone. Large repositories default to authored/requested-review
```

26	`dev git ignore --stdout/--list` remains usable outside repositories.

28	`dev repo cd <repo>` is equivalent to `dev repo open <repo> --runtime none`.
29	It preserves repository completion and resolution, always bypassing runtime
30	launch/focus. The shell wrapper consumes its directory handoff; without the
31	wrapper it prints a quoted `cd` command.
32	
33	Prefer canonical paths in new guidance. Root completion emphasizes these paths;
34	shortcut argument/flag completion stays available. Reload shell integration

37	## REPOS favorites and navigation
38	
39	On a REPOS repository parent, `f` or **Add favorite / Remove favorite** in the
40	action menu toggles durable catalog metadata, shown as `★`, without a full rescan.
41	Favorites form a stable first group after normal, column or reverse sorting;
42	within-group order, query matching and attached worktree children are preserved.
43	This is repository-only: no FLEET, TRY or individual-worktree favorites, automatic
44	recent-usage tracking, or new CLI command.
45	
46	Current-host favorites inside the current discovery scope get provisional rows
47	even without a presentation cache and priority dispatch before ordinary
48	enrichment. Normal discovery continues in the background. Missing targets stay
49	unavailable without clearing their favorite.
50	
51	Use Enter/`o` on a cached, loading, refreshing or runtime-pending REPOS row to
52	validate its exact directory, Git common-directory identity and child worktree
53	registration at action time. This does not wait for global inventory or runtime
54	listing, but runtime resolution and native Herdr handoff can still take time.
55	Non-Git directory opening remains supported. Navigation creates no task, launches
56	no agent and fetches nothing; it does not clear pending state or weaken dirty,
57	lifecycle, cleanup or batch observation guards. While searching, the first Enter
58	still exits input; a second Enter or `o` from the list opens the selection.

14	jobs:

18	  release:
19	    needs: validate
20	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
21	    env:
22	      VERSION: ${{ github.ref_name }}
23	    steps:
24	      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
25	        with:
26	          fetch-depth: 0
27	      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
28	        with:
29	          go-version-file: go.mod
30	          cache: true
31	
32	      - name: Validate stable release tag
33	        shell: bash
34	        run: |
35	          [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
36	          git fetch origin main
37	          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main
38	
39	      - name: Build tagged version
40	        run: |
41	          make build
42	          test "$(./dev --version)" = "dev version $VERSION"
43	
44	      - name: Verify independent source and Go module packages
45	        run: python3 scripts/check-distribution.py --version "$VERSION"
46	
47	      # modernc.org/sqlite is pure Go, so every target cross-compiles from one
48	      # runner with CGO disabled and ships as a static binary. Windows ships a
49	      # .zip with dev.exe; every other platform a .tar.gz with dev.
50	      - name: Build release archives
51	        run: |
52	          mkdir -p dist
53	          SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$(git show -s --format=%ct HEAD)"
54	          export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
55	          ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/cli.Version=$VERSION"
56	          for target in darwin/arm64 darwin/amd64 linux/amd64 linux/arm64 windows/amd64 windows/arm64; do
57	            os="${target%/*}"; arch="${target#*/}"
58	            bin=dev; [ "$os" = windows ] && bin=dev.exe
59	            CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS="$os" GOARCH="$arch" \
60	              go build -ldflags "$ldflags" -o "dist/$bin" ./cmd/dev
61	            touch -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" "dist/$bin"
62	            if [ "$os" = windows ]; then
63	              ( cd dist && TZ=UTC zip -X -q "dev-cli_${VERSION}_${os}_${arch}.zip" "$bin" )
64	            else
65	              tar --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -cf - -C dist "$bin" | gzip -n > "dist/dev-cli_${VERSION}_${os}_${arch}.tar.gz"
66	            fi
67	            rm "dist/$bin"
68	          done
69	          # git archive honors export-ignore, keeping conversation history out
70	          # of the source package used for native upgrades (e.g. Termux).
71	          git archive --format=tar.gz --output="dist/dev-cli_${VERSION}_source.tar.gz" "$GITHUB_SHA"
72	          ( cd dist && sha256sum -- *.tar.gz *.zip > SHA256SUMS )
73	          ls -l dist
74	
75	      # The changelog is the account a human wrote; generated notes are the
76	      # fallback for a tag whose section is missing.
77	      - name: Extract release notes
78	        run: |
79	          awk -v ver="${VERSION#v}" '
80	            $0 ~ "^## \\[" ver "\\]" { found = 1; next }
81	            found && /^## \[/ { exit }
82	            found { print }

101	
102	      # Homebrew formulas are synchronized by daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap.

1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4	
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6	
7	## [Unreleased]
8	
9	### Added
10	
11	- REPOS repository favorites: `f` or the action menu toggles a durable catalog
12	  favorite, shown with `★` and grouped first without overriding filters or the
13	  ordering within each group. Current-host favorites within discovery scope
14	  appear provisionally even without a cache and receive priority enrichment;
15	  ordinary discovery continues and unavailable targets retain their favorite.
16	- Bilingual research on human/agent work items, proposal triage and cross-devbox
17	  handoffs compares Markdown, hosted trackers, td/Sidecar, Beads/Dolt and Herdr.
18	  Task guidance distinguishes durable outcomes from change streams and agent
19	  sessions, with staged trial criteria before adding dev integrations.
20	
21	### Changed
22	
23	- Dashboard list filtering accepts `Ctrl+O` directly: it keeps the current query
24	  and selection, leaves input, and opens the normal action menu without an
25	  intermediate Enter. Closing the menu returns to the filtered list; existing
26	  action readiness and active-clone guards still apply.
27	- Lowercase `f` is now reserved for REPOS favorites. Custom tools previously
28	  bound to it must move to another available key, such as uppercase `F`.
29	- REPOS Enter/`o` validates the exact selected directory, Git common-directory
30	  identity and linked-worktree registration at action time, allowing navigation

129	## Versioning and changelog
130	
131	The current published baseline is `v0.3.3` (2026-09-25). The CLI version authority is an immutable `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` Git tag:
132	
133	- `Makefile` derives development builds with `git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*' --always --dirty` and injects `internal/cli.Version` through `-ldflags`. The `--match` filter is load-bearing: any other tag in the repository (a `backup/` or `rescue/` marker, say) must never become `--version`.
134	- `go install ...@version` recovers the module version from Go build information.
135	- `pyproject.toml` version `0.0.0` belongs only to the MkDocs environment and is not the CLI version.
136	
137	Every user-visible feature must be added to `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` as part of the feature change. Do not publish or describe a feature build under an older release's version; a release containing new compatible behavior must receive a newer version. Decide from public compatibility impact rather than blindly from the commit type.
138	
139	**When to release.** A tag is not an occasional ceremony; it is how a downstream binary learns it is stale. `go install ...@latest` resolves to the newest tag, so anything merged but untagged is invisible outside this repository.
140	
141	- A landed branch that stands alone is released immediately: bump the patch during `0.x` (`v0.1.x`) and tag it as the last step of landing.
142	- A landed branch belonging to an announced milestone accumulates in `[Unreleased]`; the milestone closes with a minor bump (`v0.2.0`).
143	- Never let `[Unreleased]` grow past one milestone's worth of work. `v0.1.0` to `v0.1.11` were tagged retroactively on 2026-08-29 precisely because 38 commits accumulated with no release.
144	
145	**What downstream gets.** Every release from `v0.2.0` forward publishes platform binaries and `SHA256SUMS` alongside the GitHub release, and `dev doctor` reports the running version so a user can compare without leaving the terminal. A release that ships neither leaves `dev --version` as the only signal, which is what the freshness work exists to fix.
146	
147	For a release:
148	
149	1. Move the relevant `[Unreleased]` entries into `## [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD` and update comparison links.
150	2. Update version-pinned install examples when the documented recommended release changes.
151	3. Push `main` first. `release.yml` asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`, so a tag pushed ahead of its branch fails validation.
152	4. Tag the exact commit on `main` as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; never move or reuse a published tag. Never push `backup/*` or `rescue/*` tags — a tag reachable from a commit that predates the `--match` filter breaks the workflow's `./dev --version` assertion.
153	5. Let `.github/workflows/release.yml` run CI, verify `./dev --version`, build the platform matrix, create the GitHub release, and update Scoop. The `daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap` repository is the single Homebrew formula writer: its hourly/manual sync validates the published assets and installs/tests the formula before committing. This repository does not need a Homebrew tap-writing token.
154	
155	To retry Homebrew synchronization, run `gh workflow run sync.yml --repo daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap -f tool=dev-cli`. This uses the tap repository’s own token and does not create or move an application tag. Stable formulas install release binaries; `brew install --HEAD daviddwlee84/tap/dev-cli` retains the source-build path.
156	
157	Stable release tags only are accepted by the current workflow; prerelease tags are not supported.

160	
161	`internal/skill/dev-cli/` is shipped product surface, not incidental prose: `internal/skill/skill.go` embeds the entire tree in the binary. A code change is incomplete when the bundled skill or public documentation still describes old behavior.

171	| Quick-note storage, identity, search, structured output, or TUI behavior | Update README, embedded help, `SKILL.md`, `references/notes.md`, and paired English/zh-TW mental-model, workflow, TUI, commands/config, compatibility, and freshness pages. |
172	| Any user-visible feature or fix | Update `CHANGELOG.md`; update README/help/MkDocs/skill wherever they make the affected claim. |

188	Source checkouts include `mise.toml`, pinning the repository toolchain to Go
189	1.26.4. With mise installed, `mise install` selects the same compiler used by
190	the module and CI instead of relying on a possibly mismatched global GOROOT.
191	
192	Every release also publishes `darwin/arm64`, `darwin/amd64`, `linux/amd64`,
193	`linux/arm64` (`.tar.gz`) and `windows/amd64`, `windows/arm64` (`.zip`) archives
194	with a `SHA256SUMS` file, so a binary can be verified without a Go toolchain.
195	
196	To find out whether the binary you have is current, and to update it:
197	
198	```bash
199	dev self version           # what this build is, and whether it is a published release
200	dev self version --check    # also ask GitHub for the newest release (cached for a day)
201	dev self doctor            # reports the running version, install owner/path, and PATH collisions
202	dev self upgrade --check    # report whether a newer release exists
203	dev self upgrade            # delegate to its owner, or verify and replace a standalone binary
204	```
205	
206	For a standalone install, `dev self upgrade` checks the release's actual asset list.
207	If this platform has an archive, it downloads and verifies `SHA256SUMS`. If the
208	platform is absent (including Android/Termux today), it offers to build the exact
209	release tag with native Go. New releases include a compact
210	`dev-cli_<tag>_source.tar.gz`, verified against `SHA256SUMS` and excluding
211	conversation history. Older releases without this asset use Go's configured
212	module verification and may download a much larger archive. Both paths use
213	two build workers and the installed toolchain; they may take several minutes
214	on the first run. The candidate must build and report the expected version before
215	replacing the old executable. Download or checksum failures stop the upgrade.
216	
217	On Termux, prepare the native tools with `pkg install golang clang git`.
218	Android builds use `GOOS=android`, CGO and Clang; Linux archives are not Android
219	substitutes. Go must satisfy that release's `go.mod`; automatic toolchain downloads
220	are disabled for source upgrades. To recover an older `dev` whose upgrade command
221	only attempts the missing Android archive, build the published version separately:
222	
223	```bash
224	pkg update && pkg upgrade -y && pkg install golang clang git curl
225	stage="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.local/bin/.dev-build.XXXXXX")" && (
226	  trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
227	  set -e
228	  version=v0.3.3
229	  asset="dev-cli_${version}_source.tar.gz"
230	  base="https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/releases/download/$version"
231	  cd "$stage"
232	  curl -fL "$base/$asset" -o "$asset"
233	  curl -fL "$base/SHA256SUMS" -o SHA256SUMS
234	  awk -v asset="$asset" '$2 == asset { print }' SHA256SUMS > source.sha256

165	        module_zip, module_source = directory / "module.zip", directory / "module"
166	        run([str(helper_binary), str(clone), oid, module, zip_version, str(module_zip), str(module_source)])
167	        result["module_zip"] = check_module(module_zip, module, zip_version, required)
168	        build_and_smoke(module_source, directory / ("module-binary" + suffix), config, version)
169	        result["module_zip"]["check_zip_unzip_build_and_smoke"] = "passed"
170	        if baseline:
171	            old = output(["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", baseline + "^{commit}"], root)
172	            old_zip = directory / "baseline-module.zip"
173	            run([str(helper_binary), str(clone), old, module, zip_version, str(old_zip), str(directory / "baseline-module")])
174	            old_archive = directory / "baseline-source.tar.gz"
175	            (clone / ".git/info/attributes").unlink()
176	            with old_archive.open("wb") as stream:
177	                run(["git", "archive", "--format=tar.gz", old], clone, stdout=stream)
178	            result["baseline"] = {"commit": old, "source_bytes": old_archive.stat().st_size, "module_zip_bytes": old_zip.stat().st_size}
179	    return result
180	
181	
182	def main():
183	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
184	    parser.add_argument("--ref", default="HEAD")
185	    parser.add_argument("--version", default="distribution-check")
186	    parser.add_argument("--baseline", help="optional pre-packaging commit for size comparison")
187	    parser.add_argument("--source-archive", type=Path, help="check and build an actual release source payload instead")
188	    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=Path("scripts/distribution.json"))
189	    args = parser.parse_args()
190	    root = Path(output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"]))
191	    config = json.loads((root / args.config).read_text())
192	    if args.source_archive:
193	        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="release-source-check-") as temporary:
194	            source = Path(temporary) / "source"
195	            source.mkdir()
196	            result = check_source(args.source_archive.resolve(), ["go.mod", "go.sum", "LICENSE", *config.get("required", [])], source)
197	            build_and_smoke(source, Path(temporary) / ("binary.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "binary"), config, args.version)
198	            print(json.dumps({"source": result, "build_and_smoke": "passed"}))
199	        return
200	    print(json.dumps(verify(root, args.ref, args.version, config, args.baseline), sort_keys=True))
201	
202	
203	if __name__ == "__main__":
204	    main()

188	    if sys.platform == "win32":

198	def run_task(task, directory):
199	    args = command(task)
200	    if command_units(args) > MAX_COMMAND:
201	        raise ValueError("Windows command length invariant failed")
202	    started = time.monotonic()
203	    log = directory / (task["id"] + ".jsonl")
204	    print("RUN", task["id"], task["package"], "all roots" if task["roots"] is None else len(task["roots"]), flush=True)
205	    with log.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
206	        process = subprocess.Popen(
207	            args, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True,
208	            encoding="utf-8", start_new_session=sys.platform != "win32",
209	        )
210	        timed_out = False
211	        try:
212	            code = process.wait(timeout=PROCESS_TIMEOUT)
213	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
214	            timed_out = True
215	            code = stop_process_tree(process)
216	    observations = observe_log(log, task)
217	    okay = (code == 0 and not timed_out and observations["package_terminal"]
218	            and observations["coverage"] and not observations["failures"])
219	    result = {
220	        "task": task, "okay": okay, "exit_code": code,
221	        "outer_timeout": timed_out, "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
222	        **observations, "log": log.name,
223	    }
224	    print("PASS" if okay else "FAIL", task["id"], "%.1fs" % result["seconds"], flush=True)
225	    if not okay:
226	        if not observations["coverage"]:
227	            print("Root coverage mismatch", json.dumps({"expected": task["roots"], **observations}), flush=True)
228	        # Keep complete logs as artifacts; print a bounded useful tail as well.
229	        print("\n".join(log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[-100:]), flush=True)
230	    return result
